1001.title: Scorpion
1001.lore: Scorpion is a kind of Desert Insect. Its solid shell bears most neutral attacks. Carries a poison at the end of its tail. Scorpions can be found in areas where there is desert. It has a beautiful color, but can be dangerous.

1002.title: Poring
1002.lore:
Poring is a jelly-type creature that is commonly seen everywhere. It's not hostile to Normans and also weak to be a recommendable monster for newbies. It tends to swallow everything in sight. Small, pink monsters that are made of a living gelatinous substance. They're cute and move by bouncing.
A round, jelly-like body that's said to hold all sorts of items lost by many adventurers.

1004.title: Hornet
1004.lore: Hornet is a working bee working so hard by a command of queen bee. It normally seeks honey, but when something dangerous happens it fights in a swarm. Usually benign, they will attack in swarms if one of them is harmed.

1005.title: Familiar
1005.lore: Familiar is a bat that lives in a group in a dark cave. It sucks blood from living things nearby using small but sharp teeth. A gray bat that's not very strong, but really annoying because it attacks very fast and relentlessly pursues passersby.

1007.title: Fabre
1007.lore: Fabres are the larvae of Creamy that are suitable for newbies to fight with. It evolves into a Pupa. Likes to roll around the grassland with its round body. The weak and small larva of Creamy. Although some say it is cute, this author must disagree. Wholeheartedly.

1008.title: Pupa
1008.lore: Pupa is a pupa of Creamy. As a pupa it is covered with a firm tough shell, but cannot move itself. A monster that is the pupal stage of Fabre, it doesn't attack at all so it's easy to kill for Novices.

1009.title: Condor
1009.lore: Condor is a kind of desert eagle. It makes a living off of leftover food from adventurers or corpses in the desert because it is too old to hunt living things. A bald, funny-looking, vulture-like bird. They tend to attack in a flock if one of them is threatened.

1010.title: Willow
1010.lore: Willow is a tree monster. Once a tree fairy had lied within but it seems the fairy's gone crazy now. The fairy had endowed a little magical ability to the monster though... Creature reborn from an old tree. The feature and the sounds it makes are incredibly eerie.

1011.title: Chonchon
1011.lore:
Chonchon is a kind of small fly that is commonly seen everywhere. They move with great speed. Amazingly, they can heal in the presence of fecal matter.
The Fly Wing item it drops does the same effect as Teleport, an Acolyte skill.

1012.title: Roda Frog
1012.lore: Roda Frog is a kind of mutant frog usually living in the forest or the grassland. They prefer to be near the water or damp places. Amphibious frogs that have an annoying croak. In some countries, their legs are a delicacy.

1013.title: Wolf
1013.lore: The Wolf is commonly seen everywhere. It fears Normans so it never initiates the attack before them. Wild, roving wolves with blue manes, they tend to attack as a pack when even one of them is threatened.

1014.title: Spore
1014.lore: Spore is a cute, chubby mushroom. Its rhythmical body-moving attracts all attention of passersby. Mushroom-like monsters that thrive in forests or dungeon. They have potbellies despite the fact that, as mushrooms, they don't actually eat.

1015.title: Zombie
1015.lore: Zombie is a walking corpse which has been cursed by an evil shaman. Beware of its poisonous breath. Bad case of the dead which has been reborn as a walking corpse by black magic. Let's lead it to Nirvana.

1016.title: Archer Skeleton
1016.lore: Archer Skeleton is a skeleton archer living in dark caves or sunless places. It is rumored that when a witch curses a man to the death, that dead man will turn into this monster with its rotten and torn body. Despite not having actual eyes, Archer Skeletons have great aim.

1018.title: Creamy
1018.lore: Creamy is the imago of a Fabre. The pipe on the mouth is supposed to be rolled out for drinking honey. It has been mutated by environmental pollution and does harm to Normans. A flying monster with beautiful wings. It will escape by teleporting if it thinks that it is in grave danger.

1019.title: Pecopeco
1019.lore: Pecopeco is a large bird that is commonly found in the desert. Although it cannot fly due to it's large body, its firm legs allow it to run faster than any other land animals. Sometimes Knights will domesticate them and ride them. Nowadays, Pecopeco is popular as mounts for Knights and Crusaders. They live in the desert or forest and will attack in flocks if one of them is threatened.

1020.title: Mandragora
1020.lore: Although Mandragora stays in the same place, it can attack passersby from a distance using underground stalks.

1023.title: Orc Warrior
1023.lore: Orc Warrior is a warrior of the Orc tribe living in the forest. It is dumb but mighty. Orcs have their language and society. They like smoking dried roll-up leaves and tend to attack Norman passersby to extort their money and goods.

1024.title: Worm Tail
1024.lore: Worm Tail is a monster living in a hidden place of the jungle. It kicks off annoying travellers who come into his forest without permission, using its long and narrow tendril. A strange monster that uses whipping attacks with a tail that looks like a blade of grass.

1026.title: Munak
1026.lore: Munak is the dead body of a young girl who had died holding a deep grudge and never goes beyond the realm of the living. She sucks blood from living things nearby to prevent her body from being more rotten. A beautiful zombie that seems to be linked to Bongun somehow.

1028.title: Soldier Skeleton
1028.lore: Soldier Skeleton is a skeletal soldier living in the sunless area. It handles 2 scimitars because it is a little dumb to use a bow and arrows as archer skeleton does. A skeleton soldier that wields two swords at once. Doesn't have much to do other than attack passersby.

1029.title: Isis
1029.lore: Isis is a giant serpent that a royal maid transformed into after death and had been buried with a king. She has been dedicated to defending the tomb of the king, so she is very hostile to those that would dare enter it. A monster that is half serpent and half woman, she is one of Osiris' trusted companions.

1030.title: Anacondaq
1030.lore:
Anacondaq is a giant snake usually living in the desert area. It's weak but deadly poisonous. Hunts small animals using its poison.
On iRO2, this monster is misspelled as Anacondac.

1031.title: Poporing
1031.lore: Poporing is a kind of Poring living in the swamp. It is covered with poisonous elastic skins all around the body. A light green Poring with the poison property. It's much stronger than Poring, but still moves by means of bouncing.

1032.title: Verit
1032.lore: Verit is a mummy dog that had been a pet dog of Mummy in the realm before its owner became a mummy. Picks up things dropped on the ground to bring them to its owner. A mummified dog that will pick up anything dropped to the ground. Although it's a zombie, it seems happy to be alive again.

1033.title: Elder Willow
1033.lore: Elder Willow is an ancient Willow in which a fairy lies within. It seems to possess magic power through its long age.

1034.title: Thara Frog
1034.lore:
Thara Frog is a mutant frog that prefers a dark, damp place. Also it is much too strong for beginners.
 Red frogs that are much stronger than the green Roda Frogs, they also produce an annoying croaking noise.

1035.title: Hunter Fly
1035.lore: Hunter Fly is a Chonchon of crimson colour. It possess 3 times higher agility compared to normal Chonchon; also it deals more damage than the normal one. Winged insects covered in the blood of innocents. It's incredibly quick as well. Novices must flee from this monster at all costs.

1036.title: Ghoul
1036.lore: Ghoul is a walking corpse that has been cursed by an evil Shaman. Mostly, it preys on dead bodies, however it never gets satisfied with those and keeps attacking the living near the place where it lives. Similar to a Zombie, but are green and much stronger. Its retching is offensive in more ways than two.

1037.title: Sidewinder
1037.lore:
Sidewinder is a snake. Unlike its legend of twin heads, apparently this snake has one head. Uses a dull tail and a head to threaten and to confuse enemies at the same time. A dark-colored snake that hates people. Be careful and kill them before they can poison you.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Side Winder.

1038.title: Osiris
1038.lore: Osiris is the King of the Sphinx. Although he had been deified as the Sun God in the ancient age, he's now nothing but a powerful boss of monsters.

1039.title: Baphomet
1039.lore:
Baphomet is a legendary notorious demon that lives in the deep jungle. He treats Norman beings as insects. The scythe he carries with him is powerful enough to slay a large number of enemies at a time. A horned goat-like beast that wields an intimidating scythe with incredible might. Sired countless Baphomet Jrs.
As Baphomet originates from the demon realm of Muspell, he is unable to fully appear in Midgard.…

1040.title: Golem
1040.lore: Golem is living stone conjured up by an ancient Magician. It is immune against physical attacks. A being of living stone that has been enchanted with black magic. It can recognize spell casting, but moves incredibly slowly due to its weight problem.

1041.title: Mummy
1041.lore: Mummy is a mummy crawling under the deserted pyramid in Morocc, appearing with Verit the undead dog before the adventurers from time to time. Tends to move in groups attacking other living things nearby. A walking corpse covered with bandages. It probably used to be beautiful once.

1042.title: Steel Chonchon
1042.lore: Steel Chonchon is a kind of Chonchon that has a firm shell covering its body. Similar to Chonchon, but is yellow green. It picks up everything from the ground so be careful not to drop items.

1044.title: Obeaune
1044.lore: Obeaune is a creature with the head and upper body of a woman and the tail of a fish. She seems to have a bad hair day, her tangled and uncombed hair harms other creatures with the slightest damage. Besides, she isn't nice to let eyesores get near her. A female mermaid that attacks with its wild, flowing hair. Whether or not its male version is Merman is still under debate.

1045.title: Marc
1045.lore: Marc is a seahorse living under the deep sea. As the solid skin covers all around its body, it's very strong so that normal adventurers might get in trouble seeing it under the sea. A proud-looking sea horse that sort of looks like a dragon. Unfortunately, you can't ride it.

1046.title: Doppelganger
1046.lore: Doppelganger is a Demon that doubles as a living person. It appears mostly in deep dungeons, transforming into a ghostly double of an adventurer and stabbing the victim in the back.

1047.title: Pecopeco Egg
1047.lore: Pecopeco Egg is the egg of a Pecopeco. The egg is quite small but the shell is very firm. It's used in many ways.

1048.title: Thief Bug Egg
1048.lore: Thief Bug Egg is the egg of a Thief Bug that hatches into several Thief Bugs. A filthy egg from a filthy Thief Bug. They make horrible omelets.

1049.title: Picky
1049.lore: Picky is the baby Pecopeco. Although it is pretty small, it will grow up fast. Lives in the desert hunting small bugs as prey. Cute little chick that may grow up to be a Pecopeco unless, of course, you kill it.

1050.title: Picky
1050.lore: Picky is the baby Pecopeco. Although it is pretty small, it will grow up fast. Lives in the desert hunting small bugs as prey. Cute little chick that may grow up to be a Pecopeco unless, of course, you kill it.

1051.title: Thief Bug
1051.lore: Thief Bug is a kind of bug that is commonly seen in a damp, dark places. It moves very fast and tends to steal items dropped on the ground. The undeveloped version of the Thief Bug. Even as babies, they're pretty disgusting. Dirty, filthy creatures that tend to work in swarms. Whatever you do, don't let them pollute the Prontera Culverts; it'll be a disaster.

1052.title: Rocker
1052.lore: Rocker is a long-horned grasshopper of a romantic turn of mind, that always play a violin. A lazy grasshopper that loves to play the violin, just like in Aesop's fable. A romantic gentleman roaming the grassland with a leaf parasol in one hand and playing the violin in the other. Most consider him as the main culprit for noise pollution.

1055.title: Muka
1055.lore: Muka is a monster cactus living in the desert. Although it's usually quite passive in the presence of travellers, it gets furious and shoots needles or cactus water toward enemies when attacked. Cute cactus commonly found in the desert. It tries to threaten passersby with its shrieks, but its noises are too funny to be scary.

1056.title: Smokie
1056.lore: Smokie is an innocent raccoon living in a deep forest. Enjoys shapeshifting with a raccoon leaf on the head. A chubby little raccoon that loves nothing better than to scamper. It's rumored to use a magic leaf to become invisible!

1057.title: Yoyo
1057.lore: Yoyo is a mischievous animal living in the deep forest. As it's rumored to be as intelligent as a Norman being, it is smart enough to make fun of travellers. Likes bananas a lot, surprise passersby by moving very quick. Pink-colored monkey. They don't just pick up everything dropped on the ground outrageously, but they are nimble and cooperative. You must be cautious of being attacked by a group.

1058.title: Metaller
1058.lore: Metaller is a desert Grasshopper that has evolved to survive in barren circumstances. Tends to steal items dropped on the ground in its sight. The evolved form of Rocker, it is dim brown and lives in the desert. This cricket will pick items up from the ground.

1059.title: Mistress
1059.lore: Mistress is the queen of the bees. Rarely appears; only when she controls working bees. The art of handling working bees is the honey pot she's carrying in hand.

1060.title: Bigfoot
1060.lore:
Bigfoot is a large, lonely bear that lives in a deep cave. He eats anything he can lay his hands on, adding to his massive bulk. He's very lazy and tends to doze off, but he becomes extremely violent when he's disturbed.
Fortunately, travelers needn't worry so lo... Although its name may be misleading, Bigfoot is actually a large bear. It walks like it owns the forest and it does.

1061.title: Nightmare
1061.lore: Nightmare is a horse which guides the wagon that leads the dead to Hel. It never gets tired, its nose blows off burning anesthetic smoke, and it's feet are ablaze with raging hellfire. A ghostly horse that radiates a violet aura of evil.

1062.title: Santa Poring
1062.lore: A special Poring wearing a Santa Hat. It usually comes out during the winter holidays.

1063.title: Lunatic
1063.lore:
Lunatic is a common kind of rodent with fluffy hair covered all around the body. It likes carrots a lot. It's very soft and fluffy without a care. Plump and shaggy monsters shaped like a rabbit. However, it won't give you a Bunny Band.
A cuddly monster that loves carrots. Its fur is so fluffy that you would want to hug it in the winter for warmth.

1064.title: Megalodon
1064.lore: Megalodon is an enchanted fish bone monster that still possesses the habituate of fish and wanders about under the deep sea. An animated fish skeleton that roams the seas. Although it looks scary, it's actually benign.

1065.title: Strouf
1065.lore: Strouf is the king of mermaids. However it's not that much stronger than normal mermaids. A lordly fish monster that looks like the god of the seas. Carries a lightning trident to fight people of the surface.

1066.title: Vadon
1066.lore:
Vadon is a kind of lobster living near the sea. It is difficult to deal damage to this monster due to its firm shell covering all around the body. Covered in a thick, protective shell, Vadons attack with powerful pincers. Although they look like crabs, their meat cannot be eaten.
On seaRO2 and iRO2, this monster is localized as Vador.

1067.title: Cornutus
1067.lore: Cornutus is a conch monster hiding in a solid shell. Normally lives near the sea of Izlude. Benign monsters that conceal themselves in hard, turban-shaped shells. They try to live as peacefully as they can in this crazy, crazy world.

1068.title: Hydra
1068.lore: Hydra is a sea flower monster that makes roots in a long range under the ground despite its small size. It attacks living things in a distance using the roots. As vegetable monsters that live near water or in the deep sea, they attack using tentacles. As a group, they're a pain in the ass.

1069.title: Swordfish
1069.lore: The Swordfish is a swordfish, appropriately named after its sharp and pointed mouth. Attacks enemies by emitting ultrasonic waves. Fish monster with a sharp, long nose that's just like a sword. Although it has googly eyes, it's a dangerous monster. Why wasn't it named Sword Nose Fish?

1070.title: Kukre
1070.lore: Kukre is a small bug living near the beach. It is pretty fast and tends to eat things on the ground. Kukre look better than Thief Bugs, but basically loot items just the same. Luckily they don't attack in groups.

1071.title: Pirate Skeleton
1071.lore: Pirate Skeleton is a dead Pirate who had been dead in a ship on the sea, wearing a pirate bandana on the head as if it wants to emphasize it is a pirate. A topless pirate skeleton that skips around in purple socks. Scourge of the seven seas.

1072.title: Kaho
1072.lore: Kaho is a Demon from another world with a blaze covering its body. It is fond of display and tries to attack smartly. The truth is he is a lesser demon who is not that strong.

1073.title: Crab
1073.lore: Crab is a creature with a solid, protective shell that is commonly seen at the sea. It is not that strong.

1074.title: Shellfish
1074.lore: Shellfish is a common sea creature that moves with 2 tiny legs.

1076.title: Skeleton
1076.lore: Skeleton is the skeleton of a dead person who had died holding a grudge. It's an undead so of course it hates living things.

1077.title: Poison Spore
1077.lore: Poison Spore is a mutant spore that possesses poison within. When it jumps around the field in a distance travelers might mistake it for normal Spores. A black-capped mushroom, it attacks adventurers in fear of being eaten, despite being poisonous and not delicious.

1078.title: Plant
1078.lore: Plants can be harvested for their herbs as well as other plant material like Stems. There are several different varieties of plants to harvest from, each with its own corresponding herb. They can be found all over Midgard, but a well-trained eye is required to spot them underneath bushes and shrubs.

1084.title: Mushroom
1084.lore:
Mushroom can be harvested for mushroooms as well as other mushroom material and chemicals such as spores and Alcohol. There are only two variety of mushrooms that can be found all over Midgard.

^Not a complete list of all items they drop.
There are also two other kinds of mushrooms--Orange Gooey Mushroom and Orange Net Mushrooms--that can only be found at Shibu's Mushroom Farm in Morocc.

1085.title: Mushroom
1085.lore:
Mushroom can be harvested for mushroooms as well as other mushroom material and chemicals such as spores and Alcohol. There are only two variety of mushrooms that can be found all over Midgard.

1086.title: Golden Thief Bug
1086.lore: The mysterious Golden Thief Bug is a Thief Bug whose shell is covered in pure gold. Its size and splendor is superior when compared to other Thief Bugs. A Thief Bug with a shell that shimmers in a brilliant, golden light. Beautiful, but still a nasty bug through and through.

1087.title: Orc Hero
1087.lore: Orc Hero is the hero of the Orc tribe who took command of the orc army during the war with Normans. His sword skills have been rumored to shake the heavens, bringing thunder and lightning.

1088.title: Vocal
1088.lore: Vocal is a captain of Rockers. It has a sweet voice, every Rocker likes him without any doubt. The violin it's carrying with gets used only as nothing but a weapon.

1089.title: Toad
1089.lore: Toad is a giant frog that dares to challenge creatures at its size. It carries several Roda Frogs with all the time.

1090.title: Mastering
1090.lore: Mastering is a giant mutant poring that always carries normal Porings with it. A giant Poring rarely seen in the Sograt Desert, Mt. Mjolnir, or the Prontera Maze. It may be the master of Porings, but... it's still a Poring.

1091.title: Dragon Fly
1091.lore:
Dragon Fly is a rare Chonchon that could be born by the probability of 1 in 1000.
Its name has been originated from the rumor that its power equals to a dragon's (in Chonchon's opinion). It is a leader of Chonchons, so it carries lots of Chonchons with it.

1092.title: Vagabond Wolf
1092.lore: The Vagabond Wolf is a rare wolf that has survived after falling behind from the pack. It leads other wolves and invades other animals to make the living.

1093.title: Eclipse
1093.lore: Eclipse is a kind of Lunatic. Unlike normal Lunatics, it is big and strong. Pretty hostile and instigates Lunatics to attack. Lord and master of all Lunatics, its attacks may be weak but it has considerable defenses.

1094.title: Ambernite
1094.lore: Ambernite is a Snail. It may be weak, but its hard shell protects it from even the toughest attacks. A snail-shaped monster, it has highly strong offense and defense. However, it is incredibly slow like all other snails.

1095.title: Andre
1095.lore: Andre is a working ant that works hard for its queen, Maya. Tends to collect things dropped on the ground. A diligent worker ant that lives for the sake of the colony. Look out, though. Hit one and you'll fight them all.

1096.title: Angeling
1096.lore: Angeling is the final evolution form of Poring! Unlike its cute appearance, it is pretty strong. It has hated Normans ever since it spotted other innocent brethren get damaged by them.

1097.title: Ant Egg
1097.lore: Ant Egg is a cluster of eggs that will become Andre, Piere or Deniro when hatched. Merely an ant egg. It can't hurt you. An ant egg that is also defenseless. Some of them actually hatch, though.

1098.title: Anubis
1098.lore: Anubis is the guardian of the Sphinx.

1099.title: Argiope
1099.lore: Argiope is a vicious, giant centipede monster that attacks passersby with poisonous fangs. A segmented millipede-type monster that will attack passersby with poison.

1100.title: Argos
1100.lore: Argos is a giant spider. A monstrous spider that will attack adventurers on sight. It's too big for adventurers to squish with their feet.

1102.title: Bathory
1102.lore: Bathory is an evil Witch who has served the demon. Always flies on a broom in the air and attacks enemies using a crystal ball she's carrying. She likes cute girly stuff. A wart-nosed witch wearing bunny boxers that will attack anything prettier than her. In other words, she attacks everyone.

1103.title: Caramel
1103.lore: Caramel is a porcupine monster that is very shy and mild. However, it doesn't like someone touching its body. Uses pointed spines as a weapon. An adorable porcupine with tiny spiky quills, it gets incredibly angry when touched.

1104.title: Coco
1104.lore: Coco is a small squirrel. It is not that strong but very fast; could be hard for newbie travelers. It has dark, piercing eyes and is always holding an Acorn. It would be cute if it didn't always have a look of utter contempt.

1105.title: Deniro
1105.lore: Deniro is a kind of ant of red colour. They live in a group and are very cooperative to attack. Also they tend to collect items dropped on the ground. The red worker ant that is faster than Pieres and Andres.

1106.title: Desert Wolf
1106.lore: The Desert Wolf is a kind of wolf that is commonly seen in the desert area. They hunt small animals of the desert using sturdy jawbone and speedy robust legs. They are all violent and aggressive to strangers; tend to attack indiscriminately. Wolves in the desert are much stronger than those living in the forest. If you strike one, you'll have to deal with the whole pack.

1107.title: Desert Wolf Baby
1107.lore:
The Desert Wolf Baby is a young Desert Wolf. Even though it looks so adorable and cute, its fangs never miss its targets or prey. A baby desert wolf that tries to threaten adventurers with its cute little yelps.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Baby Desert Wolf.

1108.title: Deviace
1108.lore: Deviace is a sea toad-shaped monster that seduces prey using a small antenna and swallows them with a maneater-shaped mouth. It never initiates attack unless somebody comes near and moves very slowly. Fish monster with a big mouth attached to a suction cup. Small, strong, and looks sort of like a watermelon.

1109.title: Deviruchi
1109.lore: Deviruchi is a cub Demon of the Demon world. Although it has never learned any magic yet, his fork is powerful without any magical assistance. A miniature demon that repeatedly stabs Normans with its pitchfork. It's cute, but nonetheless a true fiend of darkness.

1110.title: Dokebi
1110.lore:
Dokebi is a traditional Korean monster living near Payon; it is a kind of good fairy. When it's getting bored playing alone, it gives riddles to travellers. A traditional Korean demon with the power to generate wealth. Using Mammonite is no big deal to them!
Other versions of RO have translated this monster as Dokaebi in their language.

1111.title: Drainliar
1111.lore: Drainliar is a bat that lives in a group in a dark cave. It sucks blood from living things near using small but sharp teeth. It is bigger than a Familiar. A blood bat that's much stronger than Familiar, it also tends to pursue any Norman it finds.

1112.title: Drake
1112.lore: Drake is the pirate king who had died at sea while looking for treasure. He was cursed with a deadly spell by a person who held a deep grudge against him. The spell bound him and fellow pirates' souls on the ship. They are watching their treasure... A peg-legged, ghostly pirate captain that takes his leisurely time to attack the living.

1113.title: Drops
1113.lore: Drops is a mutant Poring that has been optimized to survive under the hot and dry weather of the desert. No wonder it tends to swallow things on the ground just like Poring does. The desert version of the Poring that has a pale orange color. It seems a tiny bit stronger than Poring, though.

1114.title: Dustiness
1114.lore: Dustiness is a kind of moth with a solid shell covering its body. Mostly it lives in a dark place like a dungeon, but it is seen near Mt. Mjolnir. This flying monster has a high dodge rate, so if you have low attack accuracy, you may want to leave it alone.

1115.title: Eddga
1115.lore: Eddga is an Ancient Tiger living in the deep forest that has been defied by the natives. He loves to smoke a pipe, and thinks Normans are barbarians for destroying mountains. He'll attack any traveler or adventurer that ventures into his mountains.

1116.title: Eggyra
1116.lore: Eggyra is a solid shell Egg monster. Its shell is thick and firm as much as that of Peco Peco. It is just wandering about the dungeon or somewhere else without any purpose.

1117.title: Evil Druid
1117.lore: Evil Druid was once a prominent High Priest, but a demon's curse turned him into one of the undead. As he used to be a High Priest, he is a pretty strong monster. A flamboyant evil druid, it's always using a floating spellbook that crackles with energy to cause misery to adventurers.

1118.title: Flora
1118.lore: Flora is a man-eating plant that looks similar to a sunflower. It enjoys devouring passerbys, but luckily it cannot move. If you're feeling particularly cowardly, just go around it. A man-eating plant, its parts are considered useful for Alchemists to make monsters of their own...

1119.title: Frilldora
1119.lore:
Frilldora is a lizard wearing a large brimmed muffler-like skin around the neck. 
Mostly lives in the desert area and hunts small bugs using a long thin tongue.
 Lizard with a frilly, fan-like neck. Although it looks ridiculous, it's actually pretty strong.

1120.title: Ghostring
1120.lore: Ghostring is the ghost of a dead Poring that came back to the realm holding a grudge. Normal weapons cannot do any damage to this monster at all.

1121.title: Giearth
1121.lore: Giearth is a kind of earth fairy living under the ground. It gathers ores and processes them. It rarely initiates attacks unless somebody tries to steal his possession or to attack first. Appears in a dead pit or the Ant Hell. An elderly pixie that wanders caves to gather ores. Almost a dwarf, but not quite.

1122.title: Goblin
1122.lore:
Goblins are a kind of evil fairy that are very sly and wicked. They typically wear masks, which are the tokens of goblin warriors in different tribes of goblins. Small mask-wearing monsters that viciously attack passersby. There seems to be different types that use different weapons. They seem to be very capable of engineering technology as they've been seen riding steampacks and a jetpacks.
They live in a small village that neighbors the Orc Village to the south.

1127.title: Hode
1127.lore: Hode is a giant earthworm living under the desert. It is shy, pretty cowardly, and scared of travelers, so you can just pass it by without worrying. A huge earthworm that usually hides under the ground, it can usually be found in the desert.

1128.title: Horn
1128.lore: Horn is a giant ground beetle that never cares about things going around except its business. When it's threatened, it uses scissors-like mandibles to attack enemy. Although it looks fierce, it's actually a peaceful insect. It roams around fields with a crunching sound.

1129.title: Horong
1129.lore: Horong is a monster that looks like death fire. It never has been identified where it came from or why it appears in the realm. An eerie-looking violet fireball. It's useless to use hiding skills near this vengeful spirit.

1130.title: Jakk
1130.lore:
Jakk is a strange-looking monster with a pumpkin head and wearing a tuxedo. Nobody knows where it came from, however according to the monster scholars it might be a familiar of a demon. A spooky, pumpkin-headed monster that dresses in a slick formal suit. It's been known to invade Prontera on St. Hallow's Eve in the past.
There is also a version that comes out during the Christmas season.

1131.title: Joker
1131.lore: Joker is a strange creature created by dark Magicians through lots of laboratory experimentation. It lives to protect the tower. A large enchanted playing card. If you don't have good attack accuracy, the stakes are against you when fighting Joker.

1132.title: Khalitzburg
1132.lore: Khalitzburg is the soul of a knight cursed into a suit of armor. Very powerful as it used to be a Norman Knight. It's later revealed that the Khalitzburg Knightage was part of the Glastheim Chivalry as a Khalitzburg Knight when Glastheim was still around. All members were turned into undead by Himmelmez.

1133.title: Kobold
1133.lore:
Kobolds are canine monsters that live in a pack. They can construct their own weapons, but those are mostly very crude compared to Norman's weapons. So they steal Norman weapons and use them without reconstruction.
They reside in a small village in Kordt Forest.

1138.title: Magnolia
1138.lore: Magnolia is the ghost of a Pecopeco Egg that never had been a Picky and was eaten by adventurers. As revenge, it eats all items dropped from adventurers. Cute-looking creatures that appear as large frying pans cooking an egg. They mercilessly spank all that oppose them.

1139.title: Mantis
1139.lore: Mantis is a mantis-like monster that is an expert of martial arts. Although it has sharp scythe-like legs, it refuses to use them and mostly does kicking and punching for the honor of the martial arts fighter. It wanders about fields, waving a tiny fan. An entire martial arts style is based on the movements of this insect.

1140.title: Marduk
1140.lore: Marduk is a Shaman of the aborigines living near Morocc. He spellbound his people to use them as royal guards for the tomb of their king. A gangly wizard of darkness. Look out, it knows magic!

1141.title: Marina
1141.lore: Marina is a kind of jellyfish drifting under the sea. It owns well-developed muscles; can live outside the water world. Its tentacle is elastic just like rubber; used in many ways. Transparent jellyfish that attacks by stretching their flexible bodies in a whip-like fashion. They live in cool places near water.

1142.title: Marine Sphere
1142.lore: Marine Sphere is a spherical creature drifting under the sea without an aim. When it's threatened, it explodes itself. Strange, round-shaped monsters that pulse with destructive energy. Gathering their detonators may be useful for Alchemists.

1143.title: Marionette
1143.lore: Marionette is a clutter lesser demon in a puppet which had been used in a royal puppet show. It doesn't have any shape and cannot deal damage with normal weapons. It is a monster reborn as a cursed doll that is bound to strings attached to wooden sticks.

1144.title: Marse
1144.lore: Marse is a cuttlefish living near the water or under the sea. It rotates its body and swings away its 2 long legs as whips to attack enemies. A miniature squid with miniature tentacles, how it moves through water with those tiny things is still a scientific mystery.

1145.title: Martin
1145.lore:
Martin is a mole living under the ground. Normally it stays in a small cave home, but 
sometimes it comes out of home to seek feed.

1146.title: Matyr
1146.lore: Matyr is a hound saturated with evil. It's always sleeping, but springs to action after smelling an adventurer. It is the keeper of the Sphinx that had been created by a forbidden magic. It's covered with thick dark fog all over its body and moves extremely fast.

1147.title: Maya
1147.lore: Maya is the Queen Ant with fantastic power that most people dare not face. She prefers to live undisturbed in dark damp places, but will come out from time to time to punish those that would invade her nest.

1148.title: Medusa
1148.lore: Medusa is a monster with hair composed of snakes. It is rumored to turn people into stone if you look into her eyes.

1149.title: Minorous
1149.lore: Minorous is a mysterious creature living in the farthest depths of a labyrinth. He despises the Orcs, but it doesn't matter since they live in different regions. When he runs into anyone blocking his way or disturbing his quiet life, he will chase them to th... A monster in the shape of an ox, it swings its hammer and follows the one who disturbs it.

1150.title: Moonlight Flower
1150.lore: Moonlight Flower is a middle-class demon that commands fox troops. You will be sorry if you look down on her just because of her cute appearance. A strange wild girl carrying a big bell and having 9 fox tails.

1151.title: Myst
1151.lore: Myst is a poisonous, fog-shaped monster. According to the references of monster scholars, it is considered to consist of numerous amounts of floating microorganisms. A strange monster made of mist that is attached to a phantom window.

1152.title: Orc Skeleton
1152.lore: Orc Skeleton is a skeletal undead Orc Warrior that is much more powerful than a living orc warrior. The skeleton of an orc that has been brought back to life. Even in death, orcs continue to do battle.

1153.title: Orc Zombie
1153.lore: Orc Zombie is an undead Orc Warrior. As a Zombie without sense perception, he moves pretty slowly. Orcs that have risen back from the dead. The honorable fighting spirit of the orc warrior never dies!

1154.title: Pasana
1154.lore: Pasana is a cursed soldier guarding the Pyramid. It has a duty to protect the dead master in the Pyramid.

1158.title: Phen
1158.lore: Phen is a long slim fish. Its belly skin is well-known as nourishing food to bon vivants. A blue fish with a pointed nose and sad, incredibly sad, vacant eyes.

1159.title: Phreeoni
1159.lore: Phreeoni is a mysterious monster. Nobody quite knows what it is or where it came from for that matter. An extremely strong bastard that is 40% tongue.

1160.title: Piere
1160.lore: Piere is a working ant that works hard for its queen, Maya. Tends to collect things dropped on the ground. A green worker ant that works just as diligently as Andre.

1161.title: Plankton
1161.lore: Plankton is a single-cell creature drifting on the water that is a food for fishes. Even though they seem insignificantly small, be careful not to step on them. Plankton are light and can drift on the water.

1162.title: Rafflesia
1162.lore: Rafflesias are aggressive sentient bushes that inhabit the fields around Lighthalzen. It is unsure if their existence is magical or scientific in origin.

1163.title: Raydric
1163.lore: Raydric is a cursed spirit confined to a suit of armor. It used to be a castle guard that still it has a deep attachment to protect the castle from it's enemies.

1164.title: Requiem
1164.lore: Requiem is an ancient slave that carries a heavy coffin on its back. Weary from its labor, Requiem simply collapses when attacking, hoping the coffin will hit its mark. He is one of the original settlers of Morocc region who had been drafted to construct the Sphinx. They were then cursed and became monsters by the king of the tomb and have kept the tomb from intruders.

1165.title: Sandman
1165.lore: Sandman is a sand monster living in the Morocc desert. According to Morocc folklore, it is a ghost of a man who died in the desert. The truth is it's a kind of fairy. It hates people.

1166.title: Savage
1166.lore: Savage is a wild boar living in the forest. It's mostly a very gentle, simple-minded animal except when it's upset. A wild boar that walks around grunting restlessly. Its rough-looking tusks make it hard to believe it was cute as a baby.

1167.title: Savage Babe
1167.lore:
Savage Babe is a baby Savage that is tiny and small, favored as a cute pet. It's disheartening to know that it grows up to become ugly.
On iRO and iRO2, this monster is localized as Savage Bebe.

1169.title: Skeleton Worker
1169.lore: Skeleton Worker is the skeletal dead body of a person holding a deep grudge because he had been killed by an accident in the mine. Still, he continues gathering ores within the deep pit. A reanimated skeleton of a miner that had died, but came back to abuse its health insurance policy.

1170.title: Sohee
1170.lore: Sohee is a virgin ghost that had never had a real love in her lifetime. She mostly appears near Payon, but doesn`t do much harm onto Normans. A female ghost that harbors a deep grudge. Although she is usually crying, she can become fierce upon encountering the living.

1174.title: Stainer
1174.lore: Stainer is a ladybug that eats noxious insects. Its colorful shell is favored for use in various decorations. a tiny little insect with a splendid ladybug-like shell, it can sense magic and will attack once a spell begins casting.

1175.title: Tarou
1175.lore: Tarou is a kind of rodent living in a dark place. Has white and fluffy hairs all around the body. A tiny, little white mouse. Its squeaks can be heard in the Dead Pit and the Prontera Culvert.

1176.title: Vitata
1176.lore: Vitata is an ant with a chubby, dark belly. Honey and Royal Jelly produced from them are used for the queen`s food. They are worker ants that are plump with honey. So plump they won't pick up anything.

1177.title: Zenorc
1177.lore: Zenorc is a mutated orc that is a kind of anthropoid living under the deep dungeon. Due to the lack of prey in the cave, it tends to eat things dropped on the ground. It's very shy and cowardly; never initiates attack. A dishonorable orc whose body has been cursed. They continue their shameful ways by looting items that have been dropped on the ground.

1178.title: Zerom
1178.lore: Zerom is an undead slave. Sadly, not even death will bring peace to the abusive hours of labor Zerom suffers for his Pharaoh. He is one of the original settlers of the Morocc region who had been drafted for the construction of the Sphinx. They had been cursed by the king and became monsters guarding the Sphinx from intruders.

1179.title: Whisper
1179.lore: Whisper is a bedcover-shaped monster. As a ghost it doesn't get any damage from normal weapons. It is a piece of living fabric that gives off spooky vibes. Sometimes it likes to turn invisible...

1180.title: Nine Tail
1180.lore:
Nine Tail is a smart fox of nine tails. It has rumored to shapeshift into a Norman, but the theory hasn`t been proven.
A fox with nine tails, it looks just like a regular fox but has nine lush tails. Nine Tail is a magical fox that has slowly absorbed the forest's magic for a long period of time. It is said that they can become Norman once every one thousand years.

1183.title: Chonchon
1183.lore:
Chonchon is a kind of small fly that is commonly seen everywhere. They move with great speed. Amazingly, they can heal in the presence of fecal matter.
The Fly Wing item it drops does the same effect as Teleport, an Acolyte skill.

1184.title: Fabre
1184.lore: Fabres are the larvae of Creamy that are suitable for newbies to fight with. It evolves into a Pupa. Likes to roll around the grassland with its round body. The weak and small larva of Creamy. Although some say it is cute, this author must disagree. Wholeheartedly.

1185.title: Whisper
1185.lore: Whisper is a bedcover-shaped monster. As a ghost it doesn't get any damage from normal weapons. It is a piece of living fabric that gives off spooky vibes. Sometimes it likes to turn invisible...

1188.title: Bongun
1188.lore: Bongun is a frozen male corpse that had become a monster by his own will to protect the girl, Munak. He has a tender passion for Munak; he does anything for her. A male oriental zombie who volunteered to be a monster to protect a girl who became Munak. It seems he fell in love with Munak.

1189.title: Orc Archer
1189.lore: Orc Archer is an Orc that attacks with a bow. Be careful, for it has high accuracy.

1190.title: Orc Lord
1190.lore: Orc Lord is the chief of the Orc tribe. He is far more intelligent. He wields no weapons, but prefers to mimic the Norman martial arts. Some people say he doesn't do any better right than normal Orc Warriors and tend to wonder if he really is more intelligent.

1191.title: Mimic
1191.lore: Mimic is a treasure chest that has something in it. Be careful, it's very quick.

1192.title: Wraith
1192.lore: Wraith is the undead ghost of a wicked man who had been cursed. He believes that he can revive himself by draining the life-force of others, so he lurks in the shadows waiting for victims.

1193.title: Alarm
1193.lore: Alarm is an enchanted magic alarm clock that has been made to protect the Clock Tower from intruders.

1194.title: Arclouse
1194.lore: Arclouse, or Arclouze, is an Insect that is covered with a hard, firm shell all over the body. It rolls up its body and attacks enemies.

1195.title: Rideword
1195.lore: Rideword is a monster that resembles a book and is usually found in magical libraries. It is unknown if they are a nuisance or a security measure.

1196.title: Skeleton Prisoner
1196.lore: Skeleton Prisoner is the skeleton of a man that had died in prison under a false accusation. He hates the people who put him in jail and neglected him.

1197.title: Zombie Prisoner
1197.lore:
Zombie Prisoner is the walking corpse of a prisoner in the underprison of a castle.
He must've died holding a grudge to the people who trapped him, but it seems he hates every living things now.

1199.title: Punk
1199.lore: Punk is a giant mould monster normally drfting in the air. When it spots any living things it attacks them to spread its seed.

1200.title: Zherlthsh
1200.lore:
Zherlthsh is a noble Lady of the Demon world who is very obsessive to control Normans as slaves. Her whip never miss tagets.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Zealotus.

1203.title: Mysteltainn
1203.lore: Although Mysteltainn looks like a cursed and sealed sword, apparently it is the chain wrapped around the sword that is the real monster. It uses the sword as its body to attack victims.

1204.title: Tirfing
1204.lore:
Tirfing is a monstrous sword that seems to have a mind of its own.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Ogretooth.

1205.title: Executioner
1205.lore: Although Executioner looks like a cursed and sealed sword, apparently it is the chain wrapped around the sword that is the real monster. It uses the sword as its body to attack its victims. This chain monster is very similar to Mysteltainn.

1206.title: Anolian
1206.lore: Anolian is a warrior of the Crocodile tribe, with the head of crocodile and the body of a Norman. Even though he's never been educated or trained, he's a still warrior.

1207.title: Sting
1207.lore: Sting is a mud-shaped monster that attacks in a long range.

1208.title: Wandering Man
1208.lore:
Wandering Man is a walking corpse that had been a warrior managing a wandering life. He attacks enemies using skillful fencing. He has been rumored to cut even a small flying bugs into 2 pieces without exception.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Wanderer.

1209.title: Cramp
1209.lore: Cramp is a kind of rodent living in the deep side of sewers. It looks similar to Tarou but it is very hostile and has poisonous teeth.

1211.title: Brilight
1211.lore:
Brilight is a ladybug that has been getting bigger and hostile for unknown reasons.
It lives in a dark place and attacks passersby.

1213.title: High Orc
1213.lore: High Orc is a superior Orc that posesses high intelligence and a well-constructed body when compared to other orcs. In addition to this, it is also more hostile and invades nearby villages sometimes.

1215.title: Stem Worm
1215.lore: Stem Worm is a mutant Worm Tail that has a much more powerful tendril than Worm Tail.

1216.title: Penomena
1216.lore: Penomena is similar to Hydra, but unlike the Hydra this monster can move itself and is pretty powerful. Misunderstanding could make for big time trouble. Prepare before you attack Penomena, otherwise you could be dead in no time.

1219.title: Knight of Abyss
1219.lore:
Knight of Abyss is a a knight that has served the owner of the legendary maze. It's very powerful, merciless. It is later revealed that the Knight of Abyss was formerly a member of the White Knight cavalry knightage that was part of Glastheim Chivalry when Glastheim was still a city. Members of the knightage were turned into undead by Himmelmez. 
On iRO, this monster is localized as Abysmal Knight.

1242.title: Marin
1242.lore: Marin is a mutant Poring living in the all-the-time winter area, Lutie. It doesn't care about items dropped on the ground.

1243.title: Sasquatch
1243.lore: Sasquatch is a Polar Bear living around Lutie. It is quite vicious, frequently attacking innocent travellers. The colour of its fur has been adapted to suit its environment.

1246.title: Christmas Cookie
1246.lore:
Christmas Cookie is a fairy worker that works in the Lutie Toy Factory; it likes tricks.
On iRO, this monster is localized as simply Cookie.

1247.title: Antonio
1247.lore: Antonio was a greedy and rash man who lives in Lutie. When he didn`t become the next village leader, he decided to take revenge and run away with all the toys that were made in the Toy Factory. Antonio claimed that he wanted to take over the factory because he liked it and no one else wanted to keep it running. However, after Santa did some investigation, he discovered Antonio was trying to take his job.…

1248.title: Cruiser
1248.lore: Cruiser is a toy soldier that keeps the Lutie Toy Factory from intruders. Attacks using a rifle.

1249.title: Myst Case
1249.lore: Myst Case is an enchanted toy box that appears in the toy factory of Lutie. Unlike Mimic, it doesn`t have any spirit within the box. It is very mild and gentle, never doing any harm onto visitors unless attacked first.

1250.title: Chepet
1250.lore:
Although Chepet looks like a girl carrying a weird doll, the truth is the weird doll controls the girl doll. It strikes a light using a big matchstick to attack targets.
An evil creature hiding in a pretty doll. It attacks passersby by striking matchsticks held in the doll's hand. A very rare monster since it dwells in only a few places.

1251.title: Knight of Windstorm
1251.lore: The Knight of Windstorm, or Stormy Knight, is a legendary monster in the Lutie region. According to the folklore, he brings a snowy storm with him and butchers Normans cruelly.

1252.title: Garm
1252.lore:
Garm is a giant wolf covered with ice. It lives near Lutie, attacking travellers using a sturdy jawbone and fangs.
On iRO, this monster was localized to Hatii to fit with the actual Norse mythos better.

1253.title: Gargoyle
1253.lore:
Gargoyles are stone demons that were placed at Baldr's temple Breidablik by Arkana and Zenobia Sadi Freile. They can only be brought to life with the formation of a nest, their source of magical power. Once the source of magic is destroyed, the gargoyles will return to their original stone state.
In RO, Gargoyles are lesser demons with large, wide wings on their backs. Attacks travellers from the sky using a bow. They bear no resemblance to the gargoyles from the manhwa.

1254.title: Raggler
1254.lore:
Raggler is a wounded soldier of the Raggler tribe of mutant seagulls. Although it cannot fly due to the serious injury, it walks leaning on his wooden stick.
The mail system in Rune-Midgarts is serviced by the Raggler tribe (unwounded ones, of course).

1256.title: Pest
1256.lore: Pest is an unidentified monster that even the monster scholars never have been able to identify. Does a spin attack using the covering for its eye.

1258.title: Goblin Archer
1258.lore: Goblin Archer is a Goblin that carries a bow and arrows. Although the bow is not that efficient, it is hard to dodge arrows shot by many goblins from here and there.

1259.title: Gryphon
1259.lore: Gryphon is a fabulous-looking beast with the head and wings of an eagle and the body of a lion. It can be tamed to become a mount for a Royal Guard.

1260.title: Dark Frame
1260.lore: Dark Frame is a mirror cursed by a devil. It mostly hangs on the wall but when somebody gets near to check their appearance, it reveals itself and attacks the living. It wanders about sometimes to seek victims for itself.

1261.title: Wild Rose
1261.lore: Wild Rose is a cat wearing a big ribbon on its back that is very smart and tricky. Also, it is rumored that it can be tamed by Normans as a pet.

1263.title: Wind Ghost
1263.lore: Wind Ghost is a skull monster with a green manteau. Its magic is very powerful.

1264.title: Merman
1264.lore: Merman is of a sea tribe that have ruled the water world and have targeted the world above to conquer. They mostly stay under the sea, appearing in caves near the seashore from time to time. A male mermaid race that rules in the deep sea. Usually can be found in the deep sea or a seaside cave.

1265.title: Cookie
1265.lore: Cookie is a fairy worker that works in the Lutie Toy Factory; it likes tricks.

1266.title: Aster
1266.lore: Aster is a starfish living at the sea. It is mild and gentle, never attacks first.

1267.title: Carat
1267.lore:
Carat is a demon pretending to be a pierrot riding a big ball. It can be seen around the corridors and in some room trying to entertain anyone that he can find. Although none of the undead really get his joke. 
Carat always sit on its big ball, and moves around by bouncing it here and there. 
Carat is a shy creature. It is easily scared and might attack anyone when its scared.…

1268.title: Bloody Knight
1268.lore: Bloody Knight is a high knight cursed into blood-stained armor. He used to be valiant enough to take charge of the chivalry in a castle.

1269.title: Clock
1269.lore: Clock is a monster that an ancient wall clock turned into. It is not hostile to Normans because it has existed along with them for a long, long time.

1270.title: Clock Tower Manager
1270.lore:
Clock Tower Manager is a magical creature created to manage the Clock Tower in Aldebaran. Although it never openly attacks Normans, it will show no mercy to the ones who tries to harm it or the clock tower.
NOTE: This monster is known as Tower Keeper in other versions of RO.

1271.title: Alligator
1271.lore: Alligator is a humanoid alligator that is not that hostile compared to the Crocodile tribe.

1272.title: Dark Lord
1272.lore:
Dark Lord is the the king of Demons. Rumor has it that he is considerably weaker in the mortal realm. Still, he's the one of strongest enemies to Norman adventurers.
As powerful as Dark Lord is, the life force in the realm of Midgard conflicts with his dark nature and drains a large portion of his power when attempting to enter it. Because of this, Dark Lord can only create manifestations of himself that are only a small fraction of his power, but still devastating in strength.…

1273.title: Orc Lady
1273.lore: Orc Lady is a female of the Orc tribe who uses a big giant kitchen knife as a weapon. It seems the orc tribe males think of them as beautiful. They are quick to come to the aid of their Orc Baby.

1274.title: Megalith
1274.lore: Megalith is a stone statue from an unknown island. It attacks enemies by shaking rocks around.

1275.title: Alice
1275.lore: Alice is a maid-type robot that has been taking charge of miscellaneous trifles in the Glastheim Castle. Cleaning is her daily priority in life, however she shows no mercy to intruders and attacks them driving a steel broom.

1276.title: Raydric Archer
1276.lore: Raydric Archer is a cursed armor that a dead castle guard spirit has been trapped within. Unlike Raydric, it uses a bow to attack intruders.

1277.title: Greatest General
1277.lore: Greatest General is the guardian of a village that has been beyond people's interest. Sad of being neglected, he becomes furious and attacks passerbys. Once a great patron god protecting a village, but it has been forgotten by the people. Its sadness became anger and started to attack people as it stays in one spot.…

1278.title: Stalactic Golem
1278.lore: Stalactic Golem is an advanced golem.

1279.title: Tri Joint
1279.lore: Tri Joint is an ancient creature with a hard protective shell that covers its body. It lives in a dark cave. Its fossil has been found from time to time.

1280.title: Steam Goblin
1280.lore:
Steam Goblin is a kind of Goblin that rides a masterpiece steam engine vehicle made by less-dumb goblins. Steam Rider troops is an elite group in the goblin army.
In some versions of RO, this monster is localized as Goblin Steamrider.

1281.title: Sage Worm
1281.lore: Sage Worm is a supreme worm of the worm tribes that owns high intelligence and stands high in public esteem in their own way.

1282.title: Kobold Archer
1282.lore: Kobold Archer is a kind of Kobold tribe living in the desert. They live in a small group and travel everywhere. They use quarrel as a weapon unlike the normal kobolds.

1283.title: Chimera
1283.lore: Chimera is a fire-breathing monster that resembles a lion, goat, and serpent.

1288.title: Emperium
1288.lore: Merely owning this gloriously resplendent gem is said to be a sign of being chosen by fate to wield great power.

1289.title: Maya Purple
1289.lore: Maya Purple is the mate of Maya and helps protect her along with their nest and brood.

1291.title: Wraith Dead
1291.lore: Wraith Dead is a ghost wandering aimlessly. An attack by the big mouth and teeth in its stomach is very threatening.

1293.title: Creamy Fear
1293.lore: Creamy Fear, as the name implies, is a stronger version of a Creamy that is intended to invoke fear in the hearts of adventurers that are too weak to take it down. Those who are strong enough to defeat a Creamy will be sorely disappointed when encountering a Creamy Fear.

1302.title: Dark Illusion
1302.lore: Dark Illusion rapidly closes the distance to a target and deals damage. Has a low chance to trigger Cross Impact.

1308.title: Panzer Goblin
1308.lore: Panzer Goblin is an advanced Goblin that somehow managed to harness nuclear energy to create a noteworthy jetpack.

1312.title: Turtle General
1312.lore: Turtle General is the known leader of all the turtles that reside in Turtle Island. Despite his age and the stereotype of turtles being slow, Turtle General is actually fast and agile. He has mastered the art of twin blades and very good at close combat.

1315.title: Assaulter
1315.lore: Assaulter is a ninja Turtle warrior that resides on Turtle Island. It is armed with a giant shuriken that it throws with deadly accuracy.

1317.title: Fur Seal
1317.lore:
Fur Seal is a fin-footed marine mammal that is semiaquatic. It has a sleek-body and barrel-shaped. Their bodies are well adapted to the aquatic habitat where they spend most of their lives. Due to the excessive hunting for their precious hide, Fur Seals are now threatened with extinction. Fur Seals can only be found at Kokomo Beach, Comodo.
Fur Seal is always mistaken for a Sea Otter. This is because Fur Seal has a habit of disguising itself to be a Sea Otter.…

1364.title: Assaulter
1364.lore: Assaulter is a ninja Turtle warrior that resides on Turtle Island. It is armed with a giant shuriken that it throws with deadly accuracy.

1373.title: Lord of the Dead
1373.lore:
Lord of the Dead or Lord of Death is the champion of the undead and death. She possesses unholy strength and remarkable power. She does not possess free will and her mind is inexorably entwined to Death.
Lord of the Dead originated from Hel, the Realm of the Dead. According to The Sign Quest, the Lord of the Dead is actually Lady Hel after she puts on her armor.
Lord of the Dead has a huge lance (it is known to most as Shining Spear Blade) on her right arm as her main weapon.…

1388.title: Archangeling
1388.lore:
Archangeling is an Archangel Poring.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Arc Angeling.

1392.title: Rotar Zairo
1392.lore: Rotar Zairo is a goblin that took Goblin engineering into a different direction and combines crude propellers with steam power to create a rather inefficient machine compared to his brethren.

1393.title: Mummy
1393.lore: Mummy is a mummy crawling under the deserted pyramid in Morocc, appearing with Verit the undead dog before the adventurers from time to time. Tends to move in groups attacking other living things nearby. A walking corpse covered with bandages. It probably used to be beautiful once.

1394.title: Zombie
1394.lore: Zombie is a walking corpse which has been cursed by an evil shaman. Beware of its poisonous breath. Bad case of the dead which has been reborn as a walking corpse by black magic. Let's lead it to Nirvana.

1399.title: Baphomet
1399.lore:
Baphomet is a legendary notorious demon that lives in the deep jungle. He treats Norman beings as insects. The scythe he carries with him is powerful enough to slay a large number of enemies at a time. A horned goat-like beast that wields an intimidating scythe with incredible might. Sired countless Baphomet Jrs.
As Baphomet originates from the demon realm of Muspell, he is unable to fully appear in Midgard.…

1402.title: Poison Toad
1402.lore: Poison Toad is a poisonous toad that prefers dark and wet places.

1419.title: Familiar
1419.lore: Familiar is a bat that lives in a group in a dark cave. It sucks blood from living things nearby using small but sharp teeth. A gray bat that's not very strong, but really annoying because it attacks very fast and relentlessly pursues passersby.

1420.title: Archer Skeleton
1420.lore: Archer Skeleton is a skeleton archer living in dark caves or sunless places. It is rumored that when a witch curses a man to the death, that dead man will turn into this monster with its rotten and torn body. Despite not having actual eyes, Archer Skeletons have great aim.

1421.title: Isis
1421.lore: Isis is a giant serpent that a royal maid transformed into after death and had been buried with a king. She has been dedicated to defending the tomb of the king, so she is very hostile to those that would dare enter it. A monster that is half serpent and half woman, she is one of Osiris' trusted companions.

1422.title: Hunter Fly
1422.lore: Hunter Fly is a Chonchon of crimson colour. It possess 3 times higher agility compared to normal Chonchon; also it deals more damage than the normal one. Winged insects covered in the blood of innocents. It's incredibly quick as well. Novices must flee from this monster at all costs.

1423.title: Ghoul
1423.lore: Ghoul is a walking corpse that has been cursed by an evil Shaman. Mostly, it preys on dead bodies, however it never gets satisfied with those and keeps attacking the living near the place where it lives. Similar to a Zombie, but are green and much stronger. Its retching is offensive in more ways than two.

1424.title: Sidewinder
1424.lore:
Sidewinder is a snake. Unlike its legend of twin heads, apparently this snake has one head. Uses a dull tail and a head to threaten and to confuse enemies at the same time. A dark-colored snake that hates people. Be careful and kill them before they can poison you.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Side Winder.

1425.title: Obeaune
1425.lore: Obeaune is a creature with the head and upper body of a woman and the tail of a fish. She seems to have a bad hair day, her tangled and uncombed hair harms other creatures with the slightest damage. Besides, she isn't nice to let eyesores get near her. A female mermaid that attacks with its wild, flowing hair. Whether or not its male version is Merman is still under debate.

1426.title: Marc
1426.lore: Marc is a seahorse living under the deep sea. As the solid skin covers all around its body, it's very strong so that normal adventurers might get in trouble seeing it under the sea. A proud-looking sea horse that sort of looks like a dragon. Unfortunately, you can't ride it.

1427.title: Nightmare
1427.lore: Nightmare is a horse which guides the wagon that leads the dead to Hel. It never gets tired, its nose blows off burning anesthetic smoke, and it's feet are ablaze with raging hellfire. A ghostly horse that radiates a violet aura of evil.

1428.title: Poison Spore
1428.lore: Poison Spore is a mutant spore that possesses poison within. When it jumps around the field in a distance travelers might mistake it for normal Spores. A black-capped mushroom, it attacks adventurers in fear of being eaten, despite being poisonous and not delicious.

1429.title: Argiope
1429.lore: Argiope is a vicious, giant centipede monster that attacks passersby with poisonous fangs. A segmented millipede-type monster that will attack passersby with poison.

1430.title: Argos
1430.lore: Argos is a giant spider. A monstrous spider that will attack adventurers on sight. It's too big for adventurers to squish with their feet.

1432.title: Desert Wolf
1432.lore: The Desert Wolf is a kind of wolf that is commonly seen in the desert area. They hunt small animals of the desert using sturdy jawbone and speedy robust legs. They are all violent and aggressive to strangers; tend to attack indiscriminately. Wolves in the desert are much stronger than those living in the forest. If you strike one, you'll have to deal with the whole pack.

1433.title: Deviruchi
1433.lore: Deviruchi is a cub Demon of the Demon world. Although it has never learned any magic yet, his fork is powerful without any magical assistance. A miniature demon that repeatedly stabs Normans with its pitchfork. It's cute, but nonetheless a true fiend of darkness.

1434.title: Drainliar
1434.lore: Drainliar is a bat that lives in a group in a dark cave. It sucks blood from living things near using small but sharp teeth. It is bigger than a Familiar. A blood bat that's much stronger than Familiar, it also tends to pursue any Norman it finds.

1435.title: Evil Druid
1435.lore: Evil Druid was once a prominent High Priest, but a demon's curse turned him into one of the undead. As he used to be a High Priest, he is a pretty strong monster. A flamboyant evil druid, it's always using a floating spellbook that crackles with energy to cause misery to adventurers.

1436.title: Jakk
1436.lore:
Jakk is a strange-looking monster with a pumpkin head and wearing a tuxedo. Nobody knows where it came from, however according to the monster scholars it might be a familiar of a demon. A spooky, pumpkin-headed monster that dresses in a slick formal suit. It's been known to invade Prontera on St. Hallow's Eve in the past.
There is also a version that comes out during the Christmas season.

1437.title: Joker
1437.lore: Joker is a strange creature created by dark Magicians through lots of laboratory experimentation. It lives to protect the tower. A large enchanted playing card. If you don't have good attack accuracy, the stakes are against you when fighting Joker.

1438.title: Khalitzburg
1438.lore: Khalitzburg is the soul of a knight cursed into a suit of armor. Very powerful as it used to be a Norman Knight. It's later revealed that the Khalitzburg Knightage was part of the Glastheim Chivalry as a Khalitzburg Knight when Glastheim was still around. All members were turned into undead by Himmelmez.

1439.title: High Orc
1439.lore: High Orc is a superior Orc that posesses high intelligence and a well-constructed body when compared to other orcs. In addition to this, it is also more hostile and invades nearby villages sometimes.

1440.title: Stem Worm
1440.lore: Stem Worm is a mutant Worm Tail that has a much more powerful tendril than Worm Tail.

1441.title: Penomena
1441.lore: Penomena is similar to Hydra, but unlike the Hydra this monster can move itself and is pretty powerful. Misunderstanding could make for big time trouble. Prepare before you attack Penomena, otherwise you could be dead in no time.

1442.title: Sasquatch
1442.lore: Sasquatch is a Polar Bear living around Lutie. It is quite vicious, frequently attacking innocent travellers. The colour of its fur has been adapted to suit its environment.

1443.title: Cruiser
1443.lore: Cruiser is a toy soldier that keeps the Lutie Toy Factory from intruders. Attacks using a rifle.

1444.title: Chepet
1444.lore:
Although Chepet looks like a girl carrying a weird doll, the truth is the weird doll controls the girl doll. It strikes a light using a big matchstick to attack targets.
An evil creature hiding in a pretty doll. It attacks passersby by striking matchsticks held in the doll's hand. A very rare monster since it dwells in only a few places.

1445.title: Raggler
1445.lore:
Raggler is a wounded soldier of the Raggler tribe of mutant seagulls. Although it cannot fly due to the serious injury, it walks leaning on his wooden stick.
The mail system in Rune-Midgarts is serviced by the Raggler tribe (unwounded ones, of course).

1447.title: Gryphon
1447.lore: Gryphon is a fabulous-looking beast with the head and wings of an eagle and the body of a lion. It can be tamed to become a mount for a Royal Guard.

1448.title: Dark Frame
1448.lore: Dark Frame is a mirror cursed by a devil. It mostly hangs on the wall but when somebody gets near to check their appearance, it reveals itself and attacks the living. It wanders about sometimes to seek victims for itself.

1450.title: Wind Ghost
1450.lore: Wind Ghost is a skull monster with a green manteau. Its magic is very powerful.

1451.title: Merman
1451.lore: Merman is of a sea tribe that have ruled the water world and have targeted the world above to conquer. They mostly stay under the sea, appearing in caves near the seashore from time to time. A male mermaid race that rules in the deep sea. Usually can be found in the deep sea or a seaside cave.

1452.title: Orc Lady
1452.lore: Orc Lady is a female of the Orc tribe who uses a big giant kitchen knife as a weapon. It seems the orc tribe males think of them as beautiful. They are quick to come to the aid of their Orc Baby.

1453.title: Raydric Archer
1453.lore: Raydric Archer is a cursed armor that a dead castle guard spirit has been trapped within. Unlike Raydric, it uses a bow to attack intruders.

1454.title: Tri Joint
1454.lore: Tri Joint is an ancient creature with a hard protective shell that covers its body. It lives in a dark cave. Its fossil has been found from time to time.

1455.title: Kobold Archer
1455.lore: Kobold Archer is a kind of Kobold tribe living in the desert. They live in a small group and travel everywhere. They use quarrel as a weapon unlike the normal kobolds.

1456.title: Chimera
1456.lore: Chimera is a fire-breathing monster that resembles a lion, goat, and serpent.

1457.title: Mantis
1457.lore: Mantis is a mantis-like monster that is an expert of martial arts. Although it has sharp scythe-like legs, it refuses to use them and mostly does kicking and punching for the honor of the martial arts fighter. It wanders about fields, waving a tiny fan. An entire martial arts style is based on the movements of this insect.

1458.title: Marduk
1458.lore: Marduk is a Shaman of the aborigines living near Morocc. He spellbound his people to use them as royal guards for the tomb of their king. A gangly wizard of darkness. Look out, it knows magic!

1459.title: Marionette
1459.lore: Marionette is a clutter lesser demon in a puppet which had been used in a royal puppet show. It doesn't have any shape and cannot deal damage with normal weapons. It is a monster reborn as a cursed doll that is bound to strings attached to wooden sticks.

1460.title: Matyr
1460.lore: Matyr is a hound saturated with evil. It's always sleeping, but springs to action after smelling an adventurer. It is the keeper of the Sphinx that had been created by a forbidden magic. It's covered with thick dark fog all over its body and moves extremely fast.

1461.title: Minorous
1461.lore: Minorous is a mysterious creature living in the farthest depths of a labyrinth. He despises the Orcs, but it doesn't matter since they live in different regions. When he runs into anyone blocking his way or disturbing his quiet life, he will chase them to th... A monster in the shape of an ox, it swings its hammer and follows the one who disturbs it.

1462.title: Orc Skeleton
1462.lore: Orc Skeleton is a skeletal undead Orc Warrior that is much more powerful than a living orc warrior. The skeleton of an orc that has been brought back to life. Even in death, orcs continue to do battle.

1463.title: Orc Zombie
1463.lore: Orc Zombie is an undead Orc Warrior. As a Zombie without sense perception, he moves pretty slowly. Orcs that have risen back from the dead. The honorable fighting spirit of the orc warrior never dies!

1464.title: Pasana
1464.lore: Pasana is a cursed soldier guarding the Pyramid. It has a duty to protect the dead master in the Pyramid.

1467.title: Raydric
1467.lore: Raydric is a cursed spirit confined to a suit of armor. It used to be a castle guard that still it has a deep attachment to protect the castle from it's enemies.

1469.title: Skeleton Worker
1469.lore: Skeleton Worker is the skeletal dead body of a person holding a deep grudge because he had been killed by an accident in the mine. Still, he continues gathering ores within the deep pit. A reanimated skeleton of a miner that had died, but came back to abuse its health insurance policy.

1470.title: Zerom
1470.lore: Zerom is an undead slave. Sadly, not even death will bring peace to the abusive hours of labor Zerom suffers for his Pharaoh. He is one of the original settlers of the Morocc region who had been drafted for the construction of the Sphinx. They had been cursed by the king and became monsters guarding the Sphinx from intruders.

1471.title: Nine Tail
1471.lore:
Nine Tail is a smart fox of nine tails. It has rumored to shapeshift into a Norman, but the theory hasn`t been proven.
A fox with nine tails, it looks just like a regular fox but has nine lush tails. Nine Tail is a magical fox that has slowly absorbed the forest's magic for a long period of time. It is said that they can become Norman once every one thousand years.

1472.title: Bongun
1472.lore: Bongun is a frozen male corpse that had become a monster by his own will to protect the girl, Munak. He has a tender passion for Munak; he does anything for her. A male oriental zombie who volunteered to be a monster to protect a girl who became Munak. It seems he fell in love with Munak.

1473.title: Orc Archer
1473.lore: Orc Archer is an Orc that attacks with a bow. Be careful, for it has high accuracy.

1474.title: Mimic
1474.lore: Mimic is a treasure chest that has something in it. Be careful, it's very quick.

1475.title: Wraith
1475.lore: Wraith is the undead ghost of a wicked man who had been cursed. He believes that he can revive himself by draining the life-force of others, so he lurks in the shadows waiting for victims.

1476.title: Alarm
1476.lore: Alarm is an enchanted magic alarm clock that has been made to protect the Clock Tower from intruders.

1477.title: Arclouse
1477.lore: Arclouse, or Arclouze, is an Insect that is covered with a hard, firm shell all over the body. It rolls up its body and attacks enemies.

1478.title: Rideword
1478.lore: Rideword is a monster that resembles a book and is usually found in magical libraries. It is unknown if they are a nuisance or a security measure.

1479.title: Skeleton Prisoner
1479.lore: Skeleton Prisoner is the skeleton of a man that had died in prison under a false accusation. He hates the people who put him in jail and neglected him.

1480.title: Zombie Prisoner
1480.lore:
Zombie Prisoner is the walking corpse of a prisoner in the underprison of a castle.
He must've died holding a grudge to the people who trapped him, but it seems he hates every living things now.

1481.title: Punk
1481.lore: Punk is a giant mould monster normally drfting in the air. When it spots any living things it attacks them to spread its seed.

1482.title: Zherlthsh
1482.lore:
Zherlthsh is a noble Lady of the Demon world who is very obsessive to control Normans as slaves. Her whip never miss tagets.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Zealotus.

1485.title: Mysteltainn
1485.lore: Although Mysteltainn looks like a cursed and sealed sword, apparently it is the chain wrapped around the sword that is the real monster. It uses the sword as its body to attack victims.

1486.title: Tirfing
1486.lore:
Tirfing is a monstrous sword that seems to have a mind of its own.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Ogretooth.

1487.title: Executioner
1487.lore: Although Executioner looks like a cursed and sealed sword, apparently it is the chain wrapped around the sword that is the real monster. It uses the sword as its body to attack its victims. This chain monster is very similar to Mysteltainn.

1488.title: Anolian
1488.lore: Anolian is a warrior of the Crocodile tribe, with the head of crocodile and the body of a Norman. Even though he's never been educated or trained, he's a still warrior.

1489.title: Sting
1489.lore: Sting is a mud-shaped monster that attacks in a long range.

1490.title: Wandering Man
1490.lore:
Wandering Man is a walking corpse that had been a warrior managing a wandering life. He attacks enemies using skillful fencing. He has been rumored to cut even a small flying bugs into 2 pieces without exception.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Wanderer.

1491.title: Dokebi
1491.lore:
Dokebi is a traditional Korean monster living near Payon; it is a kind of good fairy. When it's getting bored playing alone, it gives riddles to travellers. A traditional Korean demon with the power to generate wealth. Using Mammonite is no big deal to them!
Other versions of RO have translated this monster as Dokaebi in their language.

1504.title: Dullahan
1504.lore: Dullahan is a possessed suit of armor that stalks the realm of Niflheim.

1515.title: Garm Baby
1515.lore:
Garm Baby is a baby Garm. It comes to the aid of its father whenever he calls.
On iRO, this monster was localized to Baby Hatii or Hatii Babe to fit with the actual Norse mythos.

1519.title: Chung E
1519.lore:
Chung E is a creature that resides within the Suei Long Gon palace of Luoyang's Royal Tomb.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Green Maiden.

1521.title: Alice
1521.lore: Alice is a maid-type robot that has been taking charge of miscellaneous trifles in the Glastheim Castle. Cleaning is her daily priority in life, however she shows no mercy to intruders and attacks them driving a steel broom.

1525.title: Bathory
1525.lore: Bathory is an evil Witch who has served the demon. Always flies on a broom in the air and attacks enemies using a crystal ball she's carrying. She likes cute girly stuff. A wart-nosed witch wearing bunny boxers that will attack anything prettier than her. In other words, she attacks everyone.

1527.title: Clock Tower Manager
1527.lore:
Clock Tower Manager is a magical creature created to manage the Clock Tower in Aldebaran. Although it never openly attacks Normans, it will show no mercy to the ones who tries to harm it or the clock tower.
NOTE: This monster is known as Tower Keeper in other versions of RO.

1528.title: Clock
1528.lore: Clock is a monster that an ancient wall clock turned into. It is not hostile to Normans because it has existed along with them for a long, long time.

1533.title: Fur Seal
1533.lore:
Fur Seal is a fin-footed marine mammal that is semiaquatic. It has a sleek-body and barrel-shaped. Their bodies are well adapted to the aquatic habitat where they spend most of their lives. Due to the excessive hunting for their precious hide, Fur Seals are now threatened with extinction. Fur Seals can only be found at Kokomo Beach, Comodo.
Fur Seal is always mistaken for a Sea Otter. This is because Fur Seal has a habit of disguising itself to be a Sea Otter.…

1534.title: Goblin
1534.lore:
Goblins are a kind of evil fairy that are very sly and wicked. They typically wear masks, which are the tokens of goblin warriors in different tribes of goblins. Small mask-wearing monsters that viciously attack passersby. There seems to be different types that use different weapons. They seem to be very capable of engineering technology as they've been seen riding steampacks and a jetpacks.
They live in a small village that neighbors the Orc Village to the south.

1540.title: Golem
1540.lore: Golem is living stone conjured up by an ancient Magician. It is immune against physical attacks. A being of living stone that has been enchanted with black magic. It can recognize spell casting, but moves incredibly slowly due to its weight problem.

1541.title: Greatest General
1541.lore: Greatest General is the guardian of a village that has been beyond people's interest. Sad of being neglected, he becomes furious and attacks passerbys. Once a great patron god protecting a village, but it has been forgotten by the people. Its sadness became anger and started to attack people as it stays in one spot.…

1545.title: Kobold
1545.lore:
Kobolds are canine monsters that live in a pack. They can construct their own weapons, but those are mostly very crude compared to Norman's weapons. So they steal Norman weapons and use them without reconstruction.
They reside in a small village in Kordt Forest.
