1551.title: Marse
1551.lore: Marse is a cuttlefish living near the water or under the sea. It rotates its body and swings away its 2 long legs as whips to attack enemies. A miniature squid with miniature tentacles, how it moves through water with those tiny things is still a scientific mystery.

1553.title: Myst
1553.lore: Myst is a poisonous, fog-shaped monster. According to the references of monster scholars, it is considered to consist of numerous amounts of floating microorganisms. A strange monster made of mist that is attached to a phantom window.

1556.title: Poison Toad
1556.lore: Poison Toad is a poisonous toad that prefers dark and wet places.

1557.title: Rotar Zairo
1557.lore: Rotar Zairo is a goblin that took Goblin engineering into a different direction and combines crude propellers with steam power to create a rather inefficient machine compared to his brethren.

1558.title: Sandman
1558.lore: Sandman is a sand monster living in the Morocc desert. According to Morocc folklore, it is a ghost of a man who died in the desert. The truth is it's a kind of fairy. It hates people.

1559.title: Scorpion
1559.lore: Scorpion is a kind of Desert Insect. Its solid shell bears most neutral attacks. Carries a poison at the end of its tail. Scorpions can be found in areas where there is desert. It has a beautiful color, but can be dangerous.

1561.title: Smokie
1561.lore: Smokie is an innocent raccoon living in a deep forest. Enjoys shapeshifting with a raccoon leaf on the head. A chubby little raccoon that loves nothing better than to scamper. It's rumored to use a magic leaf to become invisible!

1562.title: Soldier Skeleton
1562.lore: Soldier Skeleton is a skeletal soldier living in the sunless area. It handles 2 scimitars because it is a little dumb to use a bow and arrows as archer skeleton does. A skeleton soldier that wields two swords at once. Doesn't have much to do other than attack passersby.

1566.title: Wraith Dead
1566.lore: Wraith Dead is a ghost wandering aimlessly. An attack by the big mouth and teeth in its stomach is very threatening.

1568.title: Angeling
1568.lore: Angeling is the final evolution form of Poring! Unlike its cute appearance, it is pretty strong. It has hated Normans ever since it spotted other innocent brethren get damaged by them.

1569.title: Bloody Knight
1569.lore: Bloody Knight is a high knight cursed into blood-stained armor. He used to be valiant enough to take charge of the chivalry in a castle.

1570.title: Cramp
1570.lore: Cramp is a kind of rodent living in the deep side of sewers. It looks similar to Tarou but it is very hostile and has poisonous teeth.

1571.title: Deviace
1571.lore: Deviace is a sea toad-shaped monster that seduces prey using a small antenna and swallows them with a maneater-shaped mouth. It never initiates attack unless somebody comes near and moves very slowly. Fish monster with a big mouth attached to a suction cup. Small, strong, and looks sort of like a watermelon.

1572.title: Drops
1572.lore: Drops is a mutant Poring that has been optimized to survive under the hot and dry weather of the desert. No wonder it tends to swallow things on the ground just like Poring does. The desert version of the Poring that has a pale orange color. It seems a tiny bit stronger than Poring, though.

1574.title: Elder Willow
1574.lore: Elder Willow is an ancient Willow in which a fairy lies within. It seems to possess magic power through its long age.

1575.title: Flora
1575.lore: Flora is a man-eating plant that looks similar to a sunflower. It enjoys devouring passerbys, but luckily it cannot move. If you're feeling particularly cowardly, just go around it. A man-eating plant, its parts are considered useful for Alchemists to make monsters of their own...

1576.title: Ghostring
1576.lore: Ghostring is the ghost of a dead Poring that came back to the realm holding a grudge. Normal weapons cannot do any damage to this monster at all.

1577.title: Goblin Archer
1577.lore: Goblin Archer is a Goblin that carries a bow and arrows. Although the bow is not that efficient, it is hard to dodge arrows shot by many goblins from here and there.

1578.title: Horong
1578.lore: Horong is a monster that looks like death fire. It never has been identified where it came from or why it appears in the realm. An eerie-looking violet fireball. It's useless to use hiding skills near this vengeful spirit.

1579.title: Hydra
1579.lore: Hydra is a sea flower monster that makes roots in a long range under the ground despite its small size. It attacks living things in a distance using the roots. As vegetable monsters that live near water or in the deep sea, they attack using tentacles. As a group, they're a pain in the ass.

1581.title: Vocal
1581.lore: Vocal is a captain of Rockers. It has a sweet voice, every Rocker likes him without any doubt. The violin it's carrying with gets used only as nothing but a weapon.

1587.title: Kraben
1587.lore: It is a popular belief that a man who has become an adept in the art of magic will grow wings and is able to fly. He will then turn into a Kraben and use two long pestles, used for pounding rice, as his legs and a small pestle, used for pulverizing rice, as his tail. Nothing has been said about its ways and habits save that it likes to devour dirty things. It is said that a person who becomes a Kraben will not expose or let any one touch his posterior part.…

1589.title: Mandragora
1589.lore: Although Mandragora stays in the same place, it can attack passersby from a distance using underground stalks.

1591.title: Lunatic
1591.lore:
Lunatic is a common kind of rodent with fluffy hair covered all around the body. It likes carrots a lot. It's very soft and fluffy without a care. Plump and shaggy monsters shaped like a rabbit. However, it won't give you a Bunny Band.
A cuddly monster that loves carrots. Its fur is so fluffy that you would want to hug it in the winter for warmth.

1595.title: Marin
1595.lore: Marin is a mutant Poring living in the all-the-time winter area, Lutie. It doesn't care about items dropped on the ground.

1597.title: Gargoyle
1597.lore:
Gargoyles are stone demons that were placed at Baldr's temple Breidablik by Arkana and Zenobia Sadi Freile. They can only be brought to life with the formation of a nest, their source of magical power. Once the source of magic is destroyed, the gargoyles will return to their original stone state.
In RO, Gargoyles are lesser demons with large, wide wings on their backs. Attacks travellers from the sky using a bow. They bear no resemblance to the gargoyles from the manhwa.

1603.title: Bigfoot
1603.lore:
Bigfoot is a large, lonely bear that lives in a deep cave. He eats anything he can lay his hands on, adding to his massive bulk. He's very lazy and tends to doze off, but he becomes extremely violent when he's disturbed.
Fortunately, travelers needn't worry so lo... Although its name may be misleading, Bigfoot is actually a large bear. It walks like it owns the forest and it does.

1605.title: Dark Illusion
1605.lore: Dark Illusion rapidly closes the distance to a target and deals damage. Has a low chance to trigger Cross Impact.

1606.title: Garm Baby
1606.lore:
Garm Baby is a baby Garm. It comes to the aid of its father whenever he calls.
On iRO, this monster was localized to Baby Hatii or Hatii Babe to fit with the actual Norse mythos.

1610.title: Munak
1610.lore: Munak is the dead body of a young girl who had died holding a deep grudge and never goes beyond the realm of the living. She sucks blood from living things nearby to prevent her body from being more rotten. A beautiful zombie that seems to be linked to Bongun somehow.

1611.title: Bongun
1611.lore: Bongun is a frozen male corpse that had become a monster by his own will to protect the girl, Munak. He has a tender passion for Munak; he does anything for her. A male oriental zombie who volunteered to be a monster to protect a girl who became Munak. It seems he fell in love with Munak.

1613.title: Metaling
1613.lore: Metalings were made from the blood of living machines that were believe to be called "Gigantes." Metaling is still like those other hopping blobs of gelatin in that they'll swallow whatever might be lying on the ground.

1614.title: Mineral
1614.lore: Mineral monsters are actually living stalactites. It's rumored that they are grown in a dark cave in which something inside has some sort of malicious influence over them.

1616.title: Pitman
1616.lore: Pitmans are the ghosts of dead miners that haunt old and rusted mine cars. For some reason, they can't leave this world so they just wander around the mines.

1617.title: Waste Stove
1617.lore:
Waste Stove is an ancient looking stove with a kettle on top. It has a dark matter that lives in the stove and it has a vicious teeth. It will attack anyone on sight.
In other versions of Ragnarok Online, this monster is known as Old Stove.

1618.title: Ungoliant
1618.lore: Ungoliant is a monster that inhabits the Einbroch area.

1622.title: Teddy Bear
1622.lore: Teddy Bear is a sentient stuffed animal.

1624.title: Waste Stove
1624.lore:
Waste Stove is an ancient looking stove with a kettle on top. It has a dark matter that lives in the stove and it has a vicious teeth. It will attack anyone on sight.
In other versions of Ragnarok Online, this monster is known as Old Stove.

1627.title: Anopheles
1627.lore:
Anopheles is a small swarm of insect monsters that drains the blood of its victims.
Note: The original name of this monster is Whires, which doesn't seem to correspond to anything insect-related.

1631.title: Chung E
1631.lore:
Chung E is a creature that resides within the Suei Long Gon palace of Luoyang's Royal Tomb.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Green Maiden.

1632.title: Gremlin
1632.lore: Gremlin is a malevolent imp that lives to destroy and devour any mechanical object, allowing nothing to stand in its way It is one of several monsters sent by Arkana to destroy Chaos and his friends.

1685.title: Vesper
1685.lore: Vesper is a giant mechanical behemoth that wanders the underground laboratory of the Juperos Ruins. It is suggested that it is all that is left of Vesper Newton's physical body.

1686.title: Orc Baby
1686.lore: Orc Baby is a baby Orc that attacks with an Orcish Axe of its own. It is quick to summon its Orc Warrior and Orc Lady parents when it is in need of support or help.

1688.title: Lady Tanee
1688.lore:
Lady Tanee is a female spirit that has a beautiful face with long hair. She has fragrant skin and her hands and feet are light red, like a pigeon's feet. Her lips are the color of ripen ivy gourd fruit and her body shape is similar to the trunk shape of the musa balbisiana she resides in.
Tanee may come out to seduce a man to have sexual intercourse with her. After having sex with her, the man can’t pay any attention to any other women.…

Nothing has been said about its ways and habits save that it likes to devour dirty things. It is said that a person who becomes a Kraben will not expose or let any one touch his posterior part.…

1708.title: Thanatos
1708.lore:
Thanatos (Korean: 타나토스) is a legendary powerful Warrior who defeated Surt and sealed the jotunn beneath the Morocc castle.
In the English release of the manhwa, this character is mistranslated as Tanat.

1722.title: Jakk
1722.lore:
Jakk is a strange-looking monster with a pumpkin head and wearing a tuxedo. Nobody knows where it came from, however according to the monster scholars it might be a familiar of a demon. A spooky, pumpkin-headed monster that dresses in a slick formal suit. It's been known to invade Prontera on St. Hallow's Eve in the past.
There is also a version that comes out during the Christmas season.

1725.title: Poring
1725.lore:
Poring is a jelly-type creature that is commonly seen everywhere. It's not hostile to Normans and also weak to be a recommendable monster for newbies. It tends to swallow everything in sight. Small, pink monsters that are made of a living gelatinous substance. They're cute and move by bouncing.
A round, jelly-like body that's said to hold all sorts of items lost by many adventurers.

1726.title: Lunatic
1726.lore:
Lunatic is a common kind of rodent with fluffy hair covered all around the body. It likes carrots a lot. It's very soft and fluffy without a care. Plump and shaggy monsters shaped like a rabbit. However, it won't give you a Bunny Band.
A cuddly monster that loves carrots. Its fur is so fluffy that you would want to hug it in the winter for warmth.

1727.title: Savage Babe
1727.lore:
Savage Babe is a baby Savage that is tiny and small, favored as a cute pet. It's disheartening to know that it grows up to become ugly.
On iRO and iRO2, this monster is localized as Savage Bebe.

1728.title: Desert Wolf Baby
1728.lore:
The Desert Wolf Baby is a young Desert Wolf. Even though it looks so adorable and cute, its fangs never miss its targets or prey. A baby desert wolf that tries to threaten adventurers with its cute little yelps.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Baby Desert Wolf.

1730.title: Deviruchi
1730.lore: Deviruchi is a cub Demon of the Demon world. Although it has never learned any magic yet, his fork is powerful without any magical assistance. A miniature demon that repeatedly stabs Normans with its pitchfork. It's cute, but nonetheless a true fiend of darkness.

1731.title: Doppelganger
1731.lore: Doppelganger is a Demon that doubles as a living person. It appears mostly in deep dungeons, transforming into a ghostly double of an adventurer and stabbing the victim in the back.

1734.title: Kiel-D-01
1734.lore: Kiel-D-01 is the first Fourth Generation robot created by Kiel Jr. and is a copy of his Second Generation body with significant modifications.

1735.title: Alicel
1735.lore:
Alicel is a Third Generation robot developed by the Kiel Hyre Foundation. It was mostly designed by Kiel Hyre's son, Kiel Jr. Most of the robots that were developed by Kiel Hyre foundation were sold to the Rekenber Corporation, including the Third Generation robots.

Alicel was once a student of the Kiel Hyre Academy. The academy was actually a prototype testing ground for Third Generation robots. They were trained there to interact and learn to be more like Normans.…

1736.title: Aliot
1736.lore:
Aliot is a Third Generation robot developed by the Kiel Hyre Foundation. It was mostly designed by Kiel Hyre's son, Kiel Jr. Most of the robots that were developed by Kiel Hyre foundation were sold to the Rekenber Corporation, including the Third Generation robots.

Aliot was once a student of the Kiel Hyre Academy. The academy was actually a prototype testing ground for Third Generation robots. They were trained there to interact and learn to be more like Normans.…

1737.title: Aliza
1737.lore:
Aliza is a maid type robot that has been taking charge of miscellaneous trifles in Kiel Hyre Robot Factory.
It is suggested that Aliza is a Generation 1 Kiel Hyre Robot. She was created to clean the robot factory and organize and manage factory items which no normal Norman would be able to. Like Alice, Aliza will mostly concentrate only to cleaning and finishing her task. Most likely she will not be aware of her surroundings, thus some intruders might get away just by passing her.

1739.title: Alicel
1739.lore:
Alicel is a Third Generation robot developed by the Kiel Hyre Foundation. It was mostly designed by Kiel Hyre's son, Kiel Jr. Most of the robots that were developed by Kiel Hyre foundation were sold to the Rekenber Corporation, including the Third Generation robots.

1741.title: Christmas Cookie
1741.lore:
Christmas Cookie is a fairy worker that works in the Lutie Toy Factory; it likes tricks.
On iRO, this monster is localized as simply Cookie.

1742.title: Carat
1742.lore:
Carat is a demon pretending to be a pierrot riding a big ball. It can be seen around the corridors and in some room trying to entertain anyone that he can find. Although none of the undead really get his joke. 
Carat always sit on its big ball, and moves around by bouncing it here and there. 
Carat is a shy creature. It is easily scared and might attack anyone when its scared.…

1743.title: Myst Case
1743.lore: Myst Case is an enchanted toy box that appears in the toy factory of Lutie. Unlike Mimic, it doesn`t have any spirit within the box. It is very mild and gentle, never doing any harm onto visitors unless attacked first.

1744.title: Wild Rose
1744.lore: Wild Rose is a cat wearing a big ribbon on its back that is very smart and tricky. Also, it is rumored that it can be tamed by Normans as a pet.

1746.title: Aliza
1746.lore:
Aliza is a maid type robot that has been taking charge of miscellaneous trifles in Kiel Hyre Robot Factory.
It is suggested that Aliza is a Generation 1 Kiel Hyre Robot. She was created to clean the robot factory and organize and manage factory items which no normal Norman would be able to. Like Alice, Aliza will mostly concentrate only to cleaning and finishing her task. Most likely she will not be aware of her surroundings, thus some intruders might get away just by passing her.

1748.title: Anacondaq
1748.lore:
Anacondaq is a giant snake usually living in the desert area. It's weak but deadly poisonous. Hunts small animals using its poison.
On iRO2, this monster is misspelled as Anacondac.

1749.title: Medusa
1749.lore: Medusa is a monster with hair composed of snakes. It is rumored to turn people into stone if you look into her eyes.

1750.title: Plant
1750.lore: Plants can be harvested for their herbs as well as other plant material like Stems. There are several different varieties of plants to harvest from, each with its own corresponding herb. They can be found all over Midgard, but a well-trained eye is required to spot them underneath bushes and shrubs.

1766.title: Angeling
1766.lore: Angeling is the final evolution form of Poring! Unlike its cute appearance, it is pretty strong. It has hated Normans ever since it spotted other innocent brethren get damaged by them.

1779.title: Ktullanux
1779.lore: Ktullanux is a dreadful ice beast that resides deep within the Ice Cave. One day, it was visited by priests from Sessrumnir bearing a young boy. The priests planned to use the cave as his eternal prison and so tasked Ktullanux to guard over the boy. To make sure Ktullanux does his job, the priests threaten to melt the entire cave if it does not comply.

1784.title: Stapo
1784.lore: Stapo is a Poring made of stone.

1790.title: Rafflesia
1790.lore: Rafflesias are aggressive sentient bushes that inhabit the fields around Lighthalzen. It is unsure if their existence is magical or scientific in origin.

1793.title: Megalith
1793.lore: Megalith is a stone statue from an unknown island. It attacks enemies by shaking rocks around.

1795.title: Bloody Knight
1795.lore: Bloody Knight is a high knight cursed into blood-stained armor. He used to be valiant enough to take charge of the chivalry in a castle.

1811.title: Smokie
1811.lore: Smokie is an innocent raccoon living in a deep forest. Enjoys shapeshifting with a raccoon leaf on the head. A chubby little raccoon that loves nothing better than to scamper. It's rumored to use a magic leaf to become invisible!

1814.title: Moonlight Flower
1814.lore: Moonlight Flower is a middle-class demon that commands fox troops. You will be sorry if you look down on her just because of her cute appearance. A strange wild girl carrying a big bell and having 9 fox tails.

1815.title: Rice Cake
1815.lore: A snack made out of rice that doesn't contain any fat. Some women love having this snack.

1818.title: Alarm
1818.lore: Alarm is an enchanted magic alarm clock that has been made to protect the Clock Tower from intruders.

1819.title: Bathory
1819.lore: Bathory is an evil Witch who has served the demon. Always flies on a broom in the air and attacks enemies using a crystal ball she's carrying. She likes cute girly stuff. A wart-nosed witch wearing bunny boxers that will attack anything prettier than her. In other words, she attacks everyone.

1820.title: Bigfoot
1820.lore:
Bigfoot is a large, lonely bear that lives in a deep cave. He eats anything he can lay his hands on, adding to his massive bulk. He's very lazy and tends to doze off, but he becomes extremely violent when he's disturbed.
Fortunately, travelers needn't worry so lo... Although its name may be misleading, Bigfoot is actually a large bear. It walks like it owns the forest and it does.

1821.title: Desert Wolf
1821.lore: The Desert Wolf is a kind of wolf that is commonly seen in the desert area. They hunt small animals of the desert using sturdy jawbone and speedy robust legs. They are all violent and aggressive to strangers; tend to attack indiscriminately. Wolves in the desert are much stronger than those living in the forest. If you strike one, you'll have to deal with the whole pack.

1822.title: Deviruchi

1824.lore:
Garm Baby is a baby Garm. It comes to the aid of its father whenever he calls.
On iRO, this monster was localized to Baby Hatii or Hatii Babe to fit with the actual Norse mythos.

1826.title: Myst
1826.lore: Myst is a poisonous, fog-shaped monster. According to the references of monster scholars, it is considered to consist of numerous amounts of floating microorganisms. A strange monster made of mist that is attached to a phantom window.

1827.title: Sasquatch
1827.lore: Sasquatch is a Polar Bear living around Lutie. It is quite vicious, frequently attacking innocent travellers. The colour of its fur has been adapted to suit its environment.

1836.title: Magmaring
1836.lore: Magmaring is a Poring with magma flowing over its body.

1840.title: Golden Savage
1840.lore: Golden Savage is a Savage with unusually golden hair.

1845.title: Treasure Box
1845.lore: An ancient treasure box filled with old coins, ornaments, and jewelry.

1848.title: Baphomet
1848.lore:
Baphomet is a legendary notorious demon that lives in the deep jungle. He treats Norman beings as insects. The scythe he carries with him is powerful enough to slay a large number of enemies at a time. A horned goat-like beast that wields an intimidating scythe with incredible might. Sired countless Baphomet Jrs.
As Baphomet originates from the demon realm of Muspell, he is unable to fully appear in Midgard.…

1849.title: Osiris
1849.lore: Osiris is the King of the Sphinx. Although he had been deified as the Sun God in the ancient age, he's now nothing but a powerful boss of monsters.

1850.title: Orc Hero
1850.lore: Orc Hero is the hero of the Orc tribe who took command of the orc army during the war with Normans. His sword skills have been rumored to shake the heavens, bringing thunder and lightning.

1852.title: Angeling
1852.lore: Angeling is the final evolution form of Poring! Unlike its cute appearance, it is pretty strong. It has hated Normans ever since it spotted other innocent brethren get damaged by them.

1854.title: Muka
1854.lore: Muka is a monster cactus living in the desert. Although it's usually quite passive in the presence of travellers, it gets furious and shoots needles or cactus water toward enemies when attacked. Cute cactus commonly found in the desert. It tries to threaten passersby with its shrieks, but its noises are too funny to be scary.

1855.title: Poison Spore
1855.lore: Poison Spore is a mutant spore that possesses poison within. When it jumps around the field in a distance travelers might mistake it for normal Spores. A black-capped mushroom, it attacks adventurers in fear of being eaten, despite being poisonous and not delicious.

1856.title: Magnolia
1856.lore: Magnolia is the ghost of a Pecopeco Egg that never had been a Picky and was eaten by adventurers. As revenge, it eats all items dropped from adventurers. Cute-looking creatures that appear as large frying pans cooking an egg. They mercilessly spank all that oppose them.

1857.title: Marin
1857.lore: Marin is a mutant Poring living in the all-the-time winter area, Lutie. It doesn't care about items dropped on the ground.

1858.title: Plankton
1858.lore: Plankton is a single-cell creature drifting on the water that is a food for fishes. Even though they seem insignificantly small, be careful not to step on them. Plankton are light and can drift on the water.

1859.title: Mandragora
1859.lore: Although Mandragora stays in the same place, it can attack passersby from a distance using underground stalks.

1860.title: Coco
1860.lore: Coco is a small squirrel. It is not that strong but very fast; could be hard for newbie travelers. It has dark, piercing eyes and is always holding an Acorn. It would be cute if it didn't always have a look of utter contempt.

1862.title: Martin
1862.lore:
Martin is a mole living under the ground. Normally it stays in a small cave home, but 
sometimes it comes out of home to seek feed.

1867.title: Banshee
1867.lore: Banshee is a ghostly entity that haunts the cursed monastery of Nameless Island.

1868.title: Banshee
1868.lore: Banshee is a ghostly entity that haunts the cursed monastery of Nameless Island.

1875.title: Tristan III
1875.lore: Tristan III is the late King Tristan Gaebolg III, who had been turned into an undead after being imprisoned on Nameless Island. He was eventually put to rest by a passing adventurer.

1876.title: Lord of the Dead
1876.lore:
Lord of the Dead or Lord of Death is the champion of the undead and death. She possesses unholy strength and remarkable power. She does not possess free will and her mind is inexorably entwined to Death.
Lord of the Dead originated from Hel, the Realm of the Dead. According to The Sign Quest, the Lord of the Dead is actually Lady Hel after she puts on her armor.
Lord of the Dead has a huge lance (it is known to most as Shining Spear Blade) on her right arm as her main weapon.…

Sired countless Baphomet Jrs.
As Baphomet originates from the demon realm of Muspell, he is unable to fully appear in Midgard.…

1898.title: Zombie
1898.lore: Zombie is a walking corpse which has been cursed by an evil shaman. Beware of its poisonous breath. Bad case of the dead which has been reborn as a walking corpse by black magic. Let's lead it to Nirvana.

1901.title: Condor
1901.lore: Condor is a kind of desert eagle. It makes a living off of leftover food from adventurers or corpses in the desert because it is too old to hunt living things. A bald, funny-looking, vulture-like bird. They tend to attack in a flock if one of them is threatened.

1902.title: Treasure Box
1902.lore: An ancient treasure box filled with old coins, ornaments, and jewelry.

1903.title: Treasure Box
1903.lore: An ancient treasure box filled with old coins, ornaments, and jewelry.

1916.title: Surt
1916.lore:
Surt is a Jotunn with command over the element of fire. He hails from the world of Muspelheim.
In Ragnarok Online, Surt is known as Morocc and Satan Morocc.

1926.title: Jakk
1926.lore:
Jakk is a strange-looking monster with a pumpkin head and wearing a tuxedo. Nobody knows where it came from, however according to the monster scholars it might be a familiar of a demon. A spooky, pumpkin-headed monster that dresses in a slick formal suit. It's been known to invade Prontera on St. Hallow's Eve in the past.
There is also a version that comes out during the Christmas season.

1927.title: Whisper
1927.lore: Whisper is a bedcover-shaped monster. As a ghost it doesn't get any damage from normal weapons. It is a piece of living fabric that gives off spooky vibes. Sometimes it likes to turn invisible...

1928.title: Deviruchi
1928.lore: Deviruchi is a cub Demon of the Demon world. Although it has never learned any magic yet, his fork is powerful without any magical assistance. A miniature demon that repeatedly stabs Normans with its pitchfork. It's cute, but nonetheless a true fiend of darkness.

1956.title: Nacht Sieger
1956.lore:
Nacht Sieger is a high-rank demon.
NOTE: In other versions of Ragnarok Online, this monster is commonly misspelled as Naght Sieger.

1957.title: Entweihen Crothen
1957.lore: Entweihen Crothen is a middle-rank demon that was supposedly related to Nacht Sieger as an advisor or some sort. But actually it seeks the opportunity to kill Nacht Sieger and usurp his position amongst the demons.

1964.title: Nightmare
1964.lore: Nightmare is a horse which guides the wagon that leads the dead to Hel. It never gets tired, its nose blows off burning anesthetic smoke, and it's feet are ablaze with raging hellfire. A ghostly horse that radiates a violet aura of evil.

1965.title: Wild Rose
1965.lore: Wild Rose is a cat wearing a big ribbon on its back that is very smart and tricky. Also, it is rumored that it can be tamed by Normans as a pet.

1966.title: Doppelganger
1966.lore: Doppelganger is a Demon that doubles as a living person. It appears mostly in deep dungeons, transforming into a ghostly double of an adventurer and stabbing the victim in the back.

1968.title: Strouf
1968.lore: Strouf is the king of mermaids. However it's not that much stronger than normal mermaids. A lordly fish monster that looks like the god of the seas. Carries a lightning trident to fight people of the surface.

1969.title: Marc
1969.lore: Marc is a seahorse living under the deep sea. As the solid skin covers all around its body, it's very strong so that normal adventurers might get in trouble seeing it under the sea. A proud-looking sea horse that sort of looks like a dragon. Unfortunately, you can't ride it.

1971.title: Vadon
1971.lore:
Vadon is a kind of lobster living near the sea. It is difficult to deal damage to this monster due to its firm shell covering all around the body. Covered in a thick, protective shell, Vadons attack with powerful pincers. Although they look like crabs, their meat cannot be eaten.
On seaRO2 and iRO2, this monster is localized as Vador.

1972.title: Marina
1972.lore: Marina is a kind of jellyfish drifting under the sea. It owns well-developed muscles; can live outside the water world. Its tentacle is elastic just like rubber; used in many ways. Transparent jellyfish that attacks by stretching their flexible bodies in a whip-like fashion. They live in cool places near water.

1973.title: Poring
1973.lore:
Poring is a jelly-type creature that is commonly seen everywhere. It's not hostile to Normans and also weak to be a recommendable monster for newbies. It tends to swallow everything in sight. Small, pink monsters that are made of a living gelatinous substance. They're cute and move by bouncing.
A round, jelly-like body that's said to hold all sorts of items lost by many adventurers.

1986.title: Tatacho
1986.lore: Tatachos usually sit on the ground, but will roll around if their body temperature goes down too low because of the cold weather.

1988.title: Nepenthes
1988.lore:
Nepenthes is a Plant that grew by absorbing the bad minerals of the ground. Because of this, the soil underneath the Nepenthes is known to be fertile.
On iRO2, this monster is localized as Nependes.

1997.title: Tatacho

2022.title: Nidhoggr's Shadow
2022.lore:
Nidhoggr's Shadow is the dark energy of Nidhoggr.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Nidhoggur's Shadow.

2034.title: Desert Wolf Baby
2034.lore:
The Desert Wolf Baby is a young Desert Wolf. Even though it looks so adorable and cute, its fangs never miss its targets or prey. A baby desert wolf that tries to threaten adventurers with its cute little yelps.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Baby Desert Wolf.

2039.title: Executioner
2039.lore: Although Executioner looks like a cursed and sealed sword, apparently it is the chain wrapped around the sword that is the real monster. It uses the sword as its body to attack its victims. This chain monster is very similar to Mysteltainn.

2040.title: Tirfing
2040.lore:
Tirfing is a monstrous sword that seems to have a mind of its own.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Ogretooth.

2041.title: Mysteltainn
2041.lore: Although Mysteltainn looks like a cursed and sealed sword, apparently it is the chain wrapped around the sword that is the real monster. It uses the sword as its body to attack victims.

2051.title: Baphomet
2051.lore:
Baphomet is a legendary notorious demon that lives in the deep jungle. He treats Norman beings as insects. The scythe he carries with him is powerful enough to slay a large number of enemies at a time. A horned goat-like beast that wields an intimidating scythe with incredible might. Sired countless Baphomet Jrs.
As Baphomet originates from the demon realm of Muspell, he is unable to fully appear in Midgard.…

2052.title: Dark Lord
2052.lore:
Dark Lord is the the king of Demons. Rumor has it that he is considerably weaker in the mortal realm. Still, he's the one of strongest enemies to Norman adventurers.
As powerful as Dark Lord is, the life force in the realm of Midgard conflicts with his dark nature and drains a large portion of his power when attempting to enter it. Because of this, Dark Lord can only create manifestations of himself that are only a small fraction of his power, but still devastating in strength.…

2058.title: Mimic
2058.lore: Mimic is a treasure chest that has something in it. Be careful, it's very quick.

2060.title: Alice
2060.lore: Alice is a maid-type robot that has been taking charge of miscellaneous trifles in the Glastheim Castle. Cleaning is her daily priority in life, however she shows no mercy to intruders and attacks them driving a steel broom.

2066.title: Anopheles
2066.lore:
Anopheles is a small swarm of insect monsters that drains the blood of its victims.
Note: The original name of this monster is Whires, which doesn't seem to correspond to anything insect-related.

2067.title: Anopheles
2067.lore:
Anopheles is a small swarm of insect monsters that drains the blood of its victims.
Note: The original name of this monster is Whires, which doesn't seem to correspond to anything insect-related.

2071.title: Headless Mule
2071.lore: Headless Mule is a figure in Brazilian folklore. In most tales, it is the ghost of a woman that has been cursed by God for her sins (often said to be as concubinate or fornication with a priest within a church) and condemned to turn into a fire-spewing headless mule, galloping through the countryside from Thursday's sundown to Friday's sunrise.…

2075.title: Vadon
2075.lore:
Vadon is a kind of lobster living near the sea. It is difficult to deal damage to this monster due to its firm shell covering all around the body. Covered in a thick, protective shell, Vadons attack with powerful pincers. Although they look like crabs, their meat cannot be eaten.
On seaRO2 and iRO2, this monster is localized as Vador.

2094.title: Orc Hero
2094.lore: Orc Hero is the hero of the Orc tribe who took command of the orc army during the war with Normans. His sword skills have been rumored to shake the heavens, bringing thunder and lightning.

2095.title: Eddga
2095.lore: Eddga is an Ancient Tiger living in the deep forest that has been defied by the natives. He loves to smoke a pipe, and thinks Normans are barbarians for destroying mountains. He'll attack any traveler or adventurer that ventures into his mountains.

2096.title: Osiris
2096.lore: Osiris is the King of the Sphinx. Although he had been deified as the Sun God in the ancient age, he's now nothing but a powerful boss of monsters.

2098.title: Doppelganger
2098.lore: Doppelganger is a Demon that doubles as a living person. It appears mostly in deep dungeons, transforming into a ghostly double of an adventurer and stabbing the victim in the back.

2099.title: Mistress
2099.lore: Mistress is the queen of the bees. Rarely appears; only when she controls working bees. The art of handling working bees is the honey pot she's carrying in hand.

2101.title: Lord of the Dead
2101.lore:
Lord of the Dead or Lord of Death is the champion of the undead and death. She possesses unholy strength and remarkable power. She does not possess free will and her mind is inexorably entwined to Death.
Lord of the Dead originated from Hel, the Realm of the Dead. According to The Sign Quest, the Lord of the Dead is actually Lady Hel after she puts on her armor.
Lord of the Dead has a huge lance (it is known to most as Shining Spear Blade) on her right arm as her main weapon.…

2103.title: Ktullanux
2103.lore: Ktullanux is a dreadful ice beast that resides deep within the Ice Cave. One day, it was visited by priests from Sessrumnir bearing a young boy. The priests planned to use the cave as his eternal prison and so tasked Ktullanux to guard over the boy. To make sure Ktullanux does his job, the priests threaten to melt the entire cave if it does not comply.

2105.title: Turtle General
2105.lore: Turtle General is the known leader of all the turtles that reside in Turtle Island. Despite his age and the stereotype of turtles being slow, Turtle General is actually fast and agile. He has mastered the art of twin blades and very good at close combat.

2106.title: Vesper
2106.lore: Vesper is a giant mechanical behemoth that wanders the underground laboratory of the Juperos Ruins. It is suggested that it is all that is left of Vesper Newton's physical body.

2135.title: Creeper
2135.lore:
Summons the tough vine monster. Only one vine monster can be summoned at the same time. Consumes 1 Greater Plant Bottle.

[Lv 1] : Skill duration: 120 seconds.
[Lv 2] : Skill duration: 180 seconds.
[Lv 3] : Skill duration: 240 seconds.
[Lv 4] : Skill duration: 300 seconds.
[Lv 5] : Skill duration: 360 seconds.

2147.title: Plant
2147.lore: Plants can be harvested for their herbs as well as other plant material like Stems. There are several different varieties of plants to harvest from, each with its own corresponding herb. They can be found all over Midgard, but a well-trained eye is required to spot them underneath bushes and shrubs.

2149.title: Savage Babe
2149.lore:
Savage Babe is a baby Savage that is tiny and small, favored as a cute pet. It's disheartening to know that it grows up to become ugly.
On iRO and iRO2, this monster is localized as Savage Bebe.

2152.title: Comodo
2152.lore: Comodo (Korean: 코모도) is famous for having all sorts of entertainment, certainly breaking the laws of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. But because it is so far from the capital, Prontera, the laws are not enforced as strictly.

2158.title: Hornet
2158.lore: Hornet is a working bee working so hard by a command of queen bee. It normally seeks honey, but when something dangerous happens it fights in a swarm. Usually benign, they will attack in swarms if one of them is harmed.

2209.title: Thief Bug
2209.lore: Thief Bug is a kind of bug that is commonly seen in a damp, dark places. It moves very fast and tends to steal items dropped on the ground. The undeveloped version of the Thief Bug. Even as babies, they're pretty disgusting. Dirty, filthy creatures that tend to work in swarms. Whatever you do, don't let them pollute the Prontera Culverts; it'll be a disaster.

2211.title: Teddy Bear
2211.lore: Teddy Bear is a sentient stuffed animal.

2212.title: Knight of Windstorm
2212.lore: The Knight of Windstorm, or Stormy Knight, is a legendary monster in the Lutie region. According to the folklore, he brings a snowy storm with him and butchers Normans cruelly.

2213.title: Wandering Man
2213.lore:
Wandering Man is a walking corpse that had been a warrior managing a wandering life. He attacks enemies using skillful fencing. He has been rumored to cut even a small flying bugs into 2 pieces without exception.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Wanderer.

2217.title: Teddy Bear
2217.lore: Teddy Bear is a sentient stuffed animal.

2242.title: Desert Wolf
2242.lore: The Desert Wolf is a kind of wolf that is commonly seen in the desert area. They hunt small animals of the desert using sturdy jawbone and speedy robust legs. They are all violent and aggressive to strangers; tend to attack indiscriminately. Wolves in the desert are much stronger than those living in the forest. If you strike one, you'll have to deal with the whole pack.

2289.title: Fabre
2289.lore: Fabres are the larvae of Creamy that are suitable for newbies to fight with. It evolves into a Pupa. Likes to roll around the grassland with its round body. The weak and small larva of Creamy. Although some say it is cute, this author must disagree. Wholeheartedly.

2292.title: Horn
2292.lore: Horn is a giant ground beetle that never cares about things going around except its business. When it's threatened, it uses scissors-like mandibles to attack enemy. Although it looks fierce, it's actually a peaceful insect. It roams around fields with a crunching sound.

2294.title: Argiope
2294.lore: Argiope is a vicious, giant centipede monster that attacks passersby with poisonous fangs. A segmented millipede-type monster that will attack passersby with poison.

2299.title: Stainer
2299.lore: Stainer is a ladybug that eats noxious insects. Its colorful shell is favored for use in various decorations. a tiny little insect with a splendid ladybug-like shell, it can sense magic and will attack once a spell begins casting.

2300.title: Chonchon
2300.lore:
Chonchon is a kind of small fly that is commonly seen everywhere. They move with great speed. Amazingly, they can heal in the presence of fecal matter.
The Fly Wing item it drops does the same effect as Teleport, an Acolyte skill.

2301.title: Steel Chonchon
2301.lore: Steel Chonchon is a kind of Chonchon that has a firm shell covering its body. Similar to Chonchon, but is yellow green. It picks up everything from the ground so be careful not to drop items.

2302.title: Hunter Fly
2302.lore: Hunter Fly is a Chonchon of crimson colour. It possess 3 times higher agility compared to normal Chonchon; also it deals more damage than the normal one. Winged insects covered in the blood of innocents. It's incredibly quick as well. Novices must flee from this monster at all costs.

2303.title: Maya
2303.lore: Maya is the Queen Ant with fantastic power that most people dare not face. She prefers to live undisturbed in dark damp places, but will come out from time to time to punish those that would invade her nest.

2305.title: Ungoliant
2305.lore: Ungoliant is a monster that inhabits the Einbroch area.

2306.title: Golden Thief Bug
2306.lore: The mysterious Golden Thief Bug is a Thief Bug whose shell is covered in pure gold. Its size and splendor is superior when compared to other Thief Bugs. A Thief Bug with a shell that shimmers in a brilliant, golden light. Beautiful, but still a nasty bug through and through.

2307.title: Mistress
2307.lore: Mistress is the queen of the bees. Rarely appears; only when she controls working bees. The art of handling working bees is the honey pot she's carrying in hand.

2311.title: Manananggal
2311.lore: Manananggal is a vampiric monster that resembles a beautiful woman's torso.

2313.title: Tikbalang
2313.lore: Tikbalangs are said to scare travelers and lead them astray. They play tricks on travelers to keep them returning to an arbitrary path no matter how far they go or where they turn. It is said that one can avoid being led astray by a Tikbalang by wearing one's shirt inside out. An alternative countermeasure is to ask permission to pass by out loud or not to produce too much noise while in the woods in order not to offend or disturb the Tikbalang.

2317.title: Bangungot
2317.lore: Bangungot is a vicious monster that roams the Bangungot Hospital. Some consider it more of a curse or disease. It is said that Bangungot used to be a wood fairy. It seems to have the ability to take the form of a Norman to trick people.

2319.title: Buwaya
2319.lore: Buwaya is a merciless monster that roams the forests of Malaya. It is said no living thing is left after Buwaya passes by. It was inactive for a long time, which makes people wonder if it hibernates.

2320.title: Bakonawa
2320.lore: Bakonawa is a vicious monster that was defeated by five Malayan warriors about a hundred years ago. One of the warriors received a dire wound on his leg, which caused Bakonawa to hunt after that warrior. Bakonawa then took the form of an old Norman lady and began spreading a story about how she loved her son and that she was unjustly killed by the Malayans' selfishness, which caused her anger and vengeance twisted her spirit into the monster known as Bakonawa.…

2324.lore: Penomena is similar to Hydra, but unlike the Hydra this monster can move itself and is pretty powerful. Misunderstanding could make for big time trouble. Prepare before you attack Penomena, otherwise you could be dead in no time.

2345.title: Zherlthsh
2345.lore:
Zherlthsh is a noble Lady of the Demon world who is very obsessive to control Normans as slaves. Her whip never miss tagets.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Zealotus.

2351.title: Chepet
2351.lore:
Although Chepet looks like a girl carrying a weird doll, the truth is the weird doll controls the girl doll. It strikes a light using a big matchstick to attack targets.
An evil creature hiding in a pretty doll. It attacks passersby by striking matchsticks held in the doll's hand. A very rare monster since it dwells in only a few places.

2472.title: Bloody Knight
2472.lore: Bloody Knight is a high knight cursed into blood-stained armor. He used to be valiant enough to take charge of the chivalry in a castle.

2475.title: Root of Corruption
2475.lore:
Root of Corruption is the source of the corruption that Himmelmez used to cause the fall of Glastheim. It turned the Khalitzburg and White Knight knightages into undead monsters. Although Varmundt and some adventurers manage to destroy it, the damage was already done.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Corrupted Soul.

2476.title: Amdarais
2476.lore: Amdarais was formerly a Rune Knight name Geralt. He managed to defend the Heart of Ymir located at Glastheim Castle from Himmelmez, but was eventually defeated by the valkyrie. To punish him for wasting her time, Himmelmez tortured him using her magic and then mutated him into Amdarais. Even as Amdarais, Geralt still had his mind intact and tried to stop himself from attacking his commander Heinrich and the people he was with.

2529.title: Faceworm Queen
2529.lore:
Faceworm Queen is a giant serpentine monster with a head that resembles an old man.
In the English release of the manhwa, this monster is known as Face Mask Queen.

2564.title: Fenrir
2564.lore:
Fenrir (Korean: 펜릴) is the Wolf God who was reincarnated into the Warlock Fenris Fenrir.
It is unknown where Fenrir fits into the scheme of things as both Fenris and Frigg hint that Fenrir was a part of the Thousand-Year War but that doesn't necessarily mean he participated in the war. It seems Fenrir was very familiar with Baldr as the wolf had been to Baldr's temple Breidablik (since Fenris recalled it being very grand when she visited the ruins in A.W.…

2924.title: Elder Willow
2924.lore: Elder Willow is an ancient Willow in which a fairy lies within. It seems to possess magic power through its long age.

2925.title: Willow
2925.lore: Willow is a tree monster. Once a tree fairy had lied within but it seems the fairy's gone crazy now. The fairy had endowed a little magical ability to the monster though... Creature reborn from an old tree. The feature and the sounds it makes are incredibly eerie.

2927.title: Mineral
2927.lore: Mineral monsters are actually living stalactites. It's rumored that they are grown in a dark cave in which something inside has some sort of malicious influence over them.

2931.title: Metaling
2931.lore: Metalings were made from the blood of living machines that were believe to be called "Gigantes." Metaling is still like those other hopping blobs of gelatin in that they'll swallow whatever might be lying on the ground.

2932.title: Poporing
2932.lore: Poporing is a kind of Poring living in the swamp. It is covered with poisonous elastic skins all around the body. A light green Poring with the poison property. It's much stronger than Poring, but still moves by means of bouncing.

2934.title: Archangeling
2934.lore:
Archangeling is an Archangel Poring.
On iRO, this monster is localized as Arc Angeling.

2936.title: Ghostring
2936.lore: Ghostring is the ghost of a dead Poring that came back to the realm holding a grudge. Normal weapons cannot do any damage to this monster at all.

2959.title: Torturous Redeemer
2959.lore:
The Torturous Redeemer is a demon of Muspelheim who has searched long and hard for the dread blade Tartanos. In his Norman form, he comes off as being a prince of a far off land.
In Ragnarok Online, Torturous Redeemer appears in the Cursed Knight instance.

2996.title: Celine Kimi
2996.lore: Celine Kimi is a gloomy doll that wanders the Toy Factory after the factory had been shut down. She is haunted by a mysterious phantom.

3202.title: Organic Pumpkin
3202.lore: There is a sticker on this pumpkin that says 'Certified Organic' - Blasphemous Alex

20424.title: Moonlight Flower
20424.lore: Moonlight Flower is a middle-class demon that commands fox troops. You will be sorry if you look down on her just because of her cute appearance. A strange wild girl carrying a big bell and having 9 fox tails.

20425.title: Phreeoni
20425.lore: Phreeoni is a mysterious monster. Nobody quite knows what it is or where it came from for that matter. An extremely strong bastard that is 40% tongue.

20571.title: Orc Hero
20571.lore: Orc Hero is the hero of the Orc tribe who took command of the orc army during the war with Normans. His sword skills have been rumored to shake the heavens, bringing thunder and lightning.
